Okuva ku bye mmaze okwogera, muyinza okulaba okuba omubi kye kiri, n’okuba omukyuse kye kiri; era ndowooza binaabeera byangu n’okusingawo gye muli, bwe mbinnyonnyola nga bwe biri mu bitundu byabyo ebyenjawulo; era, ku kisooka, omuntu omubi ayinza okutegeererwa ku bintu bino bisatu.

Ekisooka, ye muntu ateeka essanyu lye erisinga ku nsi, era ayagala ekitonde okusinga Katonda, n’okugaggawala kwe mu mubiri okusinga essanyu ery’omu ggulu: Asiima ebintu eby’omubiri, naye tayawula wadde okuwoomerwa ebintu eby’Omwoyo:—Newakubadde ayinza okugamba nti eggulu lisinga ensi, naye mu mazima talitwala bwe lityo gy’ali ye; singa yali akakasa okufuna ensi, yandirese eggulu, era yandisinze okwagala okusigala wano okusinga okutwalibwa eyo. Obulamu obw’obutukuvu obutuukiridde, mu maaso ga Katonda, ne mu kwagala kwe n’okumutendereza emirembe gyonna mu ggulu, tebumusanyusa mu mutima gwe nga obulamu obw’okuba omulamu bulungi, n’obugagga, n’ekitiibwa, wano ku nsi. Era newakubadde ng’ayatula mu bulimba nti ayagala Katonda okusinga byonna, naye mu mazima tawulirangako maanyi ga kwagala kwa Katonda mu ye, wabula ebirowoozo bye bisinga kuteekebwa ku nsi, oba ku masanyu g’omubiri okusinga ku Katonda. Mu bufunze, buli ayagala ensi okusinga eggulu, n’okugaggawala kw’omubiri okusinga Katonda, muntu mubi atannakyuka.

Ku luuyi olulala, omuntu akyuse yamulisibwa okulaba obulungi bwa Katonda obwegombebwa; era akkiriza ekitiibwa ekiri eri Katonda ekisuubirwa, ku kigero nti omutima gwe gukisitulirwa, ne gukiteekako okusinga ekintu kyonna mu nsi muno. Yandisinze okwagala okulaba amaaso ga Katonda, n’okubeera mu kwagala kwe okutaggwaawo n’okumutendereza, okusinga okuba n’obugagga bwonna oba amasanyu gonna ag’ensi; alaba nti ebintu ebirala byonna butaliimu, era nti tewali kirala wabula Katonda ayinza okujjuza emmeeme, era n’olwekyo, ensi k’ekwate ekkubo lyonna ly’eyagala, aterekera obugagga bwe n’essuubi lye mu ggulu, era olw’ekyo amaliridde okuleka byonna. Ng’omuliro bwe gwambuka waggulu, era ng’empiso ekwatiddwako ejjinja lya magineeti bw’etunuulira obukiika kkono bulijjo, bwe kityo emmeeme ekyuse etunuulira Katonda. Tewali kirala kiyinza kumumatiza, so tayinza kufuna ssanyu wadde ekiwummulo wabula mu kwagala kwe. Mu bufunze, bonna abakyuse batwala Katonda nga wa muwendo era bamwagala okusinga ensi yonna; n’essanyu ery’omu ggulu libasinga omuwendo okusinga okugaggawala kwabwe mu mubiri. Obujulizi bw’ebyo bye njogedde muyinza okubusanga mu bifo bino eby’Ebyawandiikibwa: (Abafiripi 3:18, 21) (Matayo 6:19, 20, 21) (Abakkolosaayi 3:1, 2, 4, 5) (Abaruumi 8:5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 18, 23) (Zabbuli 73:25, 26).

Eky’okubiri, omuntu omubi ye oyo afuula omulimu omukulu ogw’obulamu bwe okugaggawalira mu nsi, n’okutuuka ku bigendererwa bye eby’omubiri. Era newakubadde ayinza okusoma n’okuwulira, n’okukola bingi mu mirimu egy’okungulu egy’eddiini, n’okwewala ebibi ebiswaza, naye ebyo byonna bya ku mabbali bubeezi, era tafuula ddala omulimu omukulu ogw’obulamu bwe okusanyusa Katonda, n’okutuuka ku kitiibwa ekitaggwaawo, wabula agoba Katonda n’ebisigalira by’ensi, n’atamuwa buweereza busukka ku ekyo omubiri kye guyinza okufissaawo; kubanga tajja kuleka byonna olw’eggulu.

Ku luuyi olulala, omuntu akyuse ye oyo afuula okusanyusa Katonda n’okulokolebwa okweraliikirira kwe okukulu n’omulimu omukulu ogw’obulamu bwe, era atwala emikisa gyonna egy’obulamu buno ng’ebimuyamba obuyambi mu lugendo lwe olugenda mu bulamu obulala, era akozesa ekitonde nga kifugibwa wansi wa Katonda: ayagala obulamu obutukuvu, era yeegomba okweyongera okuba omutukuvu: talina kibi kyonna ky’atakyawa, era ky’ateegomba, ky’atasaba, era ky’atafuba okukiggyamu. Obulamu bwe bwonna bukwata ludda lwa Katonda; era, bw’ayonoona, kikontana n’ekyo omutima gwe n’obulamu bwe kye bitunuulira, era n’olwekyo asituka nate n’akikungubagira, era tayaŋŋanga kubeera mu kibi kyonna ky’amanyi mu bugenderevu. Tewali kintu mu nsi muno kimusinga omuwendo ky’atayinza kuwaayo eri Katonda, n’akireka ku lulwe, n’olw’essuubi ly’ekitiibwa.—Ebyo byonna muyinza okubiraba mu (Abakkolosaayi 3:1, 2, 3, 4, 5) (Matayo 6:20, 33) (Lukka 18:22, 23, 29) (Lukka 14:18, 24, 26, 27) (Abaruumi 8:13) (Abaggalatiya 5:24) (Lukka 12:21), n’ebirala.

Eky’okusatu, emmeeme y’omuntu omubi teyetegerezangako ddala era teyawoomerwa kyama kya kununulibwa, wadde okwaniriza n’okwebaza Omulokozi agiweereddwa; so tesanyusibwa kwagala kwa Mununuzi, wadde okwagala okufugibwa ye ng’omusawo w’emmeeme ye, alyoke alokolebwe okuva mu musango n’obuyinza bw’ebibi bye, n’azzibwa eri Katonda; wabula omutima gwe tegufaayo ku mugaso guno ogutayogerekeka, era gukontana ddala n’eddagala erimuwonya lye yandizzibwamu. Newakubadde ayinza okukkiriza okuba omuntu w’eddiini mu ngeri ey’omubiri, naye tawaayo mmeeme ye eri Kristo, n’eri okukubiriza n’okuluŋŋamya kw’ekigambo kye n’Omwoyo we.

Ku luuyi olulala, emmeeme ekyuse, bw’emala okuwulira nga ezikiridde olw’ekibi, n’etegeera nti efiiriddwa emirembe gyayo ne Katonda, n’essuubi ly’eggulu, era nti eri mu kabi ak’okubonaabona okutaggwaawo, eyaniriza n’okwebaza amawulire g’okununulibwa, era, ng’ekkiriza Mukama Yesu ng’Omulokozi waayo yekka, yeewaayo gy’ali okuba amagezi gaayo, obutuukirivu, okutukuzibwa, n’okununulibwa; atwala Kristo ng’obulamu bw’emmeeme ye, n’abeera mulamu ku bubwe, n’amukozesa ng’eddagala erisiigibwa ku buli kiwundu, ng’eyewuunya amagezi n’okwagala kwa Katonda mu mulimu guno ogw’ekitalo ogw’okununula omuntu. Mu bufunze, Kristo abeera ddala mu mutima gwe olw’okukkiriza, era obulamu bw’alina kaakano abulina lwa kukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda, eyamwagala ne yeewaayo yekka ku lulwe; weewaawo, si ye ennyo abeera omulamu, wabula Kristo mu ye. Ku bino, laba (Yobu 1:11, 12, ne 3:20) (Yokaana 15:2, 3, 4) (1 Abakkolinso 1:20, ne 2:2).

Kaakano mulaba mu bigambo ebyangu, okuva mu kigambo kya Katonda, ababi be baani n’abakyuse be baani. Abantu abatamanyi balowooza nti omuntu bw’aba nga talayira, takolima, tavuma, si mutamiivu, si mwenzi, si munyazi, era nga tayisa bubi muntu yenna mu by’akola nabo, era nga ajja mu kkanisa, n’asaba essaala ze, n’alya ku Kijjulo kya Mukama, era ebiseera ebimu n’agololera abaavu omukono okubayamba, omuntu ng’oyo tayinza kuba atakyuse. Oba omuntu eyali omutamiivu, oba omulayizi, oba omuzannyi wa zzaala, oba ow’ebibi ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo, bw’abyerekereza bwerekereza okuva kaakano, balowooza nti oyo mukyuse.—Abalala balowooza nti omuntu eyali omulabe w’okutya Katonda era ng’akusekerera, bw’atandika okukusiima, ne yeegatta ku abo abatya Katonda, n’akyayibwa ababi olw’ekyo nga n’abatya Katonda bwe bakyayibwa, oyo ateekwa okuba ng’akyuse. Abalala basirusiru nnyo ne balowooza nti bakyuse olw’okukwata endowooza empya. Ate abalala balowooza nti bwe baba nga baatiisibwatiisibwa entiisa ya ggeyeena, ne bakakasibwa ebibi byabwe, ne babonyaabonyezebwa omuntu ow’omunda, ne kibaviirako okumalirira n’okusuubiza okwerongoosa, ne batandika obulamu obw’empisa ennungi n’eddiini ey’okungulu, ekyo kiteekwa okuba okukyuka okwa nnamaddala. Era bano be bantu abaavu abalimbiddwa abali kumpi okufiirwa omugaso gw’okubasendasenda kwaffe kwonna; era bwe bawulira nti ababi bateekwa okukyuka oba okufa, balowooza nti ekyo tekyogerwa gye bali; kubanga bo si babi, wabula baakyuka dda. Era eyo y’ensonga lwaki Kristo yagamba abamu ku bakulembeze b’Abayudaaya abaali beegendereza era nga ba mpisa okusinga abantu aba bulijjo, nti “abasolooza b’omusolo ne bamalaaya balibasooka okuyingira mu bwakabaka” bwa Kristo (Matayo 21:31). Si nti malaaya oba omwonoonyi ow’ebibi eby’olwatu ayinza okulokolebwa nga takyuse, wabula kubanga kyali kyangu okuleetera aboonoonyi abo ab’ebibi eby’olwatu okutegeera ekibi kyabwe n’obuyinike bwabwe, n’obwetaavu bw’okukyusibwa, okusinga abo ab’empisa ennungi abeerimba nga balowooza nti baakyuka dda, so nga tebakyuka.

Abange, okukyuka mulimu gwa ngeri ndala okusinga abasinga obungi bwe bamanyi; si nsonga ntono okuleeta omutima ogw’ensi mu ggulu, n’okulaga omuntu obulungi bwa Katonda obwagalibwa, okutuusa lw’anaawambibwa okwagala gy’ali okw’engeri eyo, okutayinza kuzikizibwa n’akatono; okumenya omutima olw’ekibi, n’okumuleetera okuddukira eri Kristo okufuna obuddukiro, n’okumwaniriza n’okwebaza ng’obulamu bw’emmeeme ye; okukyusa ddala ekigendererwa n’okwegomba kw’omutima n’obulamu; omuntu n’alekayo kye yali alowooza nti ye ssanyu lye, n’asimba essanyu lye we yali tasimbangako, n’aba nga takyabeera mulamu lwa kigendererwa kye kimu, era nga takyawondera nteekateeka y’emu mu nsi nga bwe yakolanga edda: mu bigambo ebitono, omuntu yenna bw’abeera mu Kristo, aba kitonde kiggya: “eby’edda nga bigenze, laba ng’afuuse muggya.” (2 Abakkolinso 5:17). Afuna okutegeera okuggya, okwagala n’okumalirira okuggya, ennaku empya, n’okwegomba, n’okwagala, n’essanyu: ebirowoozo ebiggya, ebigambo ebiggya, ab’omukwano abaggya, (bwe kiba kisoboka) n’empisa empya. Ekibi, ekyali eky’okusaaga gy’ali edda, kaakano kimwenyinyaza era kimutiisa nnyo, n’akiddukako ng’adduka okufa. Ensi, eyali ennungi ennyo mu maaso ge, kaakano erabika butaliimu na kwetamwa: Katonda, eyali alagajjalirwa edda, kaakano ye ssanyu lyokka ery’emmeeme ye; edda yali yeerabirwa, era buli kwegomba kwasookanga mu maaso ge: naye kaakano ateekebwa kumpi n’omutima, era buli kintu kiteekwa okumuviira, era omutima gubeera gwemalidde ku kumuweereza n’okumugondera, era gunakuwala bw’akweka amaaso ge, era tegulowooza nti guli bulungi nga taliiwo. Kristo yennyini, eyali alowoozebwako kitono, kaakano ye ssuubi lye lyokka n’obuddukiro bwe, era abeera mulamu ku ye nga ku mmere ye eya buli lunaku; tayinza kusaba nga taliiwo, wadde okusanyuka nga taliiwo, wadde okulowooza, wadde okwogera, wadde okubeera omulamu nga taliiwo.—Eggulu lyennyini, edda lye yatunuuliranga ng’ekyokwekuumira obwekuumizi ekigumiikirizika, kye yali asuubira nti kinaamugasa okusinga ggeyeena, bw’atandiyinza kweyongera kubeera mu nsi, kaakano alitwala ng’ewaabwe, ekifo ky’essuubi lye lyokka n’ekiwummulo kye, gy’aliraba Katonda oyo, n’amwagala, n’amutendereza, Katonda eyamala okutwala omutima gwe. Ggeyeena, eyali erabika ng’ekikange obukange ekitiisa abantu baleme kwonoona, kaakano erabika ng’okubonaabona okwa nnamaddala, okutasaanidde kwetantalwako wadde okusaagirwako.—Emirimu gy’obutukuvu, gye yakoowanga edda, era nga girabika ng’emitawaana egisukka ku byetaagisa, kaakano kwe kwesanyusa kwe, n’omulimu gwe, n’omulimu gw’akolera mw’abeera omulamu. Bayibuli, eyali gy’ali kumpi ng’ekitabo eky’olusaanyusaanyu, kaakano eri ng’amateeka ga Katonda, ng’ebbaluwa gye yawandiikirwa okuva mu ggulu, era eteekeddwako erinnya ly’Ow’Ekitiibwa Ataggwaawo; y’efuga ebirowoozo bye, n’ebigambo bye, n’ebikolwa bye; ebiragiro byayo bimusiba, okulabula kwayo kutiisa, n’ebisuubizo byayo byogera obulamu eri emmeeme ye. Abatya Katonda, abaali balabika gy’ali ng’abantu abalala bonna, kaakano be basinga obulungi n’essanyu ku nsi. Ate ababi abaali banne b’azannya nabo, kaakano bamunakuwaza; era oyo eyasekeranga ebibi byabwe, kaakano yeetegefu okusinga okukaabira ekibi kyabwe n’obuyinike bwabwe (Zabbuli 16:3 ne 15:4; Abafiripi 3:18). Mu bimpimpi, alina ekigendererwa ekiggya mu birowoozo bye, n’ekkubo eriggya mu by’afuba, era noolwekyo omutima gwe n’obulamu bwe biggya. Edda, okwerowoozaako okw’omubiri kwe kwali ekigendererwa kye; n’amasanyu ge, n’amagoba ag’ensi, n’ekitiibwa, ge gaali ekkubo lye; naye kaakano Katonda n’ekitiibwa ekitaggwaawo bye kigendererwa kye; ne Kristo, n’Omwoyo, n’ekigambo, n’ebiragiro bya Katonda, obutukuvu eri Katonda, n’obutuukirivu, n’okusaasira abantu, ebyo bye kkubo lye. Edda, okwerowoozaako kwe kwali omufuzi asinga; ebya Katonda n’eby’omuntu ow’omunda ne biteekwa okukukutamira n’okukuviira. Naye kaakano Katonda mu Kristo, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo, mu kigambo ne mu buweereza, ye mufuzi omukulu, era eri ye okwerowoozaako n’ebintu byonna eby’okwerowoozaako biteekwa okuviira. N’olwekyo kuno si kukyuka mu nsonga emu, oba bbiri, oba amakumi abiri, wabula mu mmeeme yonna, ne mu kigendererwa kyennyini n’okwegomba kw’obulamu. Omuntu ayinza okuva mu kkubo erimu n’ayingira mu ddala, kyokka amaaso ge ne gakyatunuulidde eruuyi lwe lumu, era n’akyagenda mu kifo kye kimu: Naye kiba kintu kirala okukyukira ddala emabega, n’atambula olugendo lwe mu kkubo erikontana, ng’alaga mu kifo ekikontana. Bwe kiri ne wano: omuntu ayinza okuva mu butamiivu n’adda mu kwekomako, n’aleka ab’emikwano be ab’okunywa, n’ebibi ebirala eby’olwatu eby’ensonyi, n’atandika emirimu egimu egy’eddiini, kyokka n’akyagenda mu kigendererwa kye kimu nga bwe kyali edda, ng’okwerowoozaako okw’omubiri kw’ateeka waggulu wa byonna, era ng’akyakuwa obufuzi ku mmeeme ye. Naye bw’akyuka, okwerowoozaako kuno kwegaanibwa ne kussibwa wansi, Katonda n’agulumizibwa, n’amaaso ge ne gakyuka ne gatunula eruuyi olulala; era oyo eyali yeemalidde ku ye yennyini, ng’abeerawo ku lulwe yekka, kaakano olw’okutukuzibwa yeewaddeyo eri Katonda, era abeerawo ku lwa Katonda. Edda yeebuuzanga ky’anaakola n’ekiseera kye, n’ebitone bye, n’ebintu bye, n’abikozesa ku lulwe; naye kaakano abuuza Katonda ky’anaabikozesa, n’abikozesa ku lwa Katonda. Edda yali ayagala okusanyusa Katonda kasita kitakontana na ssanyu ly’omubiri gwe n’okwerowoozaako kwe, naye nga tabinyiiza nnyo. Naye kaakano ajja kusanyusa Katonda, omubiri n’okwerowoozaako ne bwe binaanyiiga bitya. Eno y’enkyukakyuka ennene Katonda gy’alikola ku abo bonna abalirokolebwa.

Muyinza okugamba nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu y’atutukuza; naye mumanyi okutukuzibwa kye ki? Kale, kye kino kye mbannyonnyodde kaakano; era buli musajja na buli mukazi mu nsi ateekwa okuba nakyo, oba okusalirwa omusango okubonaabona emirembe gyonna. Bateekwa okukyuka oba okufa.

Kino kyonna mukikkiriza, oba temukikkiriza? Mazima temuyinza kwaŋŋanga kugamba nti temukikkiriza; kubanga tekiriimu kubuusabuusa wadde okuwakanyizibwa. Zino si nkaayana, ng’omuntu omu omuyivu atya Katonda alina endowooza emu, n’omulala endowooza endala; ng’ekibiina ekimu kigamba bwe kiti, n’ekirala kigamba bwe kiti; buli kibiina mu ffe ekisaanira okuyitibwa Abakristaayo kikkiriziganya ku kino kye njogedde; era bwe mutakkiriza Katonda ow’amazima, era nga mu nsonga omwo buli kibiina kimukkiriza, temulina kya kwewolereza n’akatono.

Naye bwe muba nga kino mukikkiriza, kiba kitya nti mubeera bulungi nnyo nga muli mu mbeera y’obutakyuka? Mumanyi nti mukyuse? era muyinza okulaba enkyukakyuka eno ey’ekitalo ku mmeeme zammwe? Mwazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri bwe mutyo, ne mufuulibwa abaggya?—Bino si bintu bya kyewuunyo eri bangi ku mmwe? era bye mutawulirangako ku mmwe mwennyini? Bwe muba nga temuyinza kumanya lunaku oba wiiki enkyukakyuka yammwe lwe yabaawo, oba okubuulira kwennyini okwabakyusa, mukyalaba nti omulimu gwakolebwa; nti enkyukakyuka ng’eyo ddala weeri, era nti mulina emitima nga gye nnyonnyodde waggulu? Woowe! Abasinga obungi bagoberera emirimu gyabwe egy’ensi, ne batatawaanya nnyo mitima gyabwe na birowoozo ng’ebyo: era bwe baba nga bakugiddwa bukugirwa okuva mu bibi eby’ekivve, era nga basobola okugamba nti, “Siri mwenzi, wadde omubbi, wadde omukolimi, wadde omulayizi, wadde omunywi w’omwenge, wadde omunyazi; ŋŋenda mu kkanisa, era nsaba essaala zange;” balowooza nti okwo kwe kukyuka okwa nnamaddala, era nti balirokolebwa nga omuntu omulala yenna. Woowe, kuno kwe kwerimba okw’obusirusiru; kuno kunyooma nnyo ekitiibwa ekitaggwaawo, era kulagajjalira nnyo emmeeme zammwe ezitafa.—Muyinza okutwala eggulu ne ggeyeena ng’ebintu ebyangu bwe biti? Emirambo gyammwe mu bbanga ttono gijja kugalamira mu nfuufu, ne bamalayika oba dayimooni ne bawamba amangu emmeeme zammwe, era buli musajja na buli mukazi ku mmwe mwenna mu bbanga ttono ajja kuba mu kibiina kirala, ne mu mbeera endala okusinga gye mulimu kaakano; mujja kubeera mu nnyumba ezo okumala akaseera katono kokka, mujja kukolera mu madduuka gammwe okumala akaseera katono kokka; mujja kutuula ku ntebe zino, n’okubeera ku nsi eno, okumala akaseera katono kokka; mujja kulaba n’amaaso ago, n’okuwulira n’amatu ago, n’okwogera n’ennimi ezo, okumala akaseera katono kokka; okutuusa ku lunaku olw’okuzuukira: era muyinza okufuba ne mukyerabira? Woowe, mu kifo ki eky’essanyu oba eky’okubonaabona mwe mujja okubeera mu bbanga ttono! Woowe, ndaba ki gye mujja okulaba mu bbanga ttono mu ggulu oba mu ggeyeena! Woowe, birowoozo ki ebijja okujjuza emitima gyammwe mu bbanga ttono essanyu eritayogerekeka oba entiisa! Mulimu ki gwe mujja okukola: okutendereza Mukama wamu n’abatukuvu ne bamalayika, oba okukaaba mu muliro ogutazikira wamu ne dayimooni! Era bino byonna byandyerabiddwa? Era bino byonna tebiriggwaawo, era bisibiddwa n’ekiragiro ekitakyuka; OBUTAGGWAAWO, OBUTAGGWAAWO bwe bulibeera ekipimo ky’essanyu lyammwe oba ennaku zammwe: Era kino kiyinza okwerabirwa? Era bino byonna bya mazima, bya mazima ddala ddala.—Bwe mulimala okutambulatambula akaseera katono, ne mwebaka ne muzuukuka emirundi mitono emirala, mujja kuba mufudde nga mugenze, ne musanga nga byonna bye mbabuulira kaakano bya mazima. Era naye mukyayinza okukyerabira ennyo bwe mutyo kaakano? Mu kiseera ekyo mulijjukira nti mwawulira okubuulira kuno, era nti olunaku lwa leero, okuva mu kifo kino, mwajjukizibwa ebintu bino; era mulitegeera nga bintu bikulu emirundi lukumi okusinga mmwe oba nze bwe twandisobodde okubirowoozaako; era naye kaakano binaayerabirwa bwe bityo?

Abaagalwa, singa Mukama teyanzuukusa kukkiriza n’okussa ku mutima ebintu bino nze kennyini, nandisigadde mu mbeera ey’ekizikiza n’okwerowoozaako, ne nzikirira emirembe gyonna: naye bw’aba nga ddala ampadde okubitegeera, kijja kumpaliriza okubasaasira nga bwe nneesaasira nze kennyini. Singa amaaso gammwe gaggulibwa okutuuka okulaba ggeyeena, ne mulaba baliraanwa bammwe abataali bakyuse nga bawalulirwayo nga bakaaba n’amaloboozi ag’entiisa, newaakubadde nga baali abo be mwatwalanga ng’abantu ab’ensa ku nsi, era nga bo bennyini tebaatya nsonga ng’eyo, okulaba okwo kwandibaleetedde okuddayo awaka ne mukirowoozaako; ne mukiddamu okukirowoozaako, ne kubaleetera okulabula bonna ababeetoolodde, ng’omuntu oyo ow’ensi eyasalirwa omusango mu Lukka 16:28 bwe yandyagadde baganda be okulabulwa, baleme kujja mu kifo ekyo ekirimu okubonaabona. Kale, okukkiriza kika kya kulaba; lye liiso ly’emmeeme, bwe bukakafu bw’ebintu ebitalabika. Bwe nzikiriza Katonda, kiba kumpi ng’okulaba; noolwekyo mbeegayiridde munsonyiwe, bwe mba nga mbanyiikiridde ku nsonga zino kitundu kyokka ku ekyo nga bwe nnandibadde singa nnali mbirabye. Singa nnali wa kufa enkya, era nga kiri mu buyinza bwange okudda nga nva mu nsi endala, ne mbabuulira bye nnalaba, temwandyagadde kumpuliriza? era temwandikkirizza ne mufaayo ku bye nnandibabuulidde? Singa nnaliyinza okubabuulira omulundi gumu nga mmaze okufa, era nga ndabye ebikolebwa mu nsi ejja, temwandyagadde njogere mazima mu lwatu era temwandikunganye okumpulira? era temwandikissizza ku mutima? Naye ekyo tekisoboka; Katonda alina engeri ye gye yateekawo ey’okubayigiriza ng’ayita mu byawandiikibwa ne mu baweereza be, era tagenda kusanyusa batakkiriza okutuuka n’okubaweereza abantu okuva mu bafu, n’okukyusa engeri ye gye yanyweza. Omuntu bw’ayombesa enjuba, Katonda tagenda kumusanyusa okutuuka n’okuteekawo omusana ogusingako okwaka. Ab’emikwano, mbeegayiridde, kaakano muntunuulire nga bwe mwandintunuulidde singa nnali nva mu bafu ne nzija gye muli; kubanga, nsobola okubakakasa amazima g’ebyo bye mbagamba nga bwe nnandibakakasizza singa nnali ndiyo ne mbirabako n’amaaso gange: Kubanga, kisoboka omuntu ava mu bafu okubalimba; naye Yesu Kristo tayinza kubalimba n’akatono: naye Yesu Kristo tayinza kubalimba n’akatono.—Ekigambo kya Katonda, ekyaweebwa mu byawandiikibwa, era ekyassibwako akabonero n’ebyamagero n’emirimu emitukuvu egy’Omwoyo, tekiyinza kubalimba n’akatono. Mukkirize kino, oba temukkiriza kintu kyonna. Mukkirize kino era mukigondere, oba muba muwedde. Kaakano, nga bwe mukkiriza ekigambo kya Katonda, era nga bwe mufaayo ku bulokozi bw’emmeeme zammwe, ka mbeegayirire ekintu kino eky’amagezi; era mbeegayiridde temungaana: nti, awatali kulwawo kwonna nate, bwe munaamala okuva wano, mujjukire bye muwulidde, era mutandike okukebera emitima gyammwe n’obunyiikivu, era mwegambe nti, “Ddala bwe kiri? Nteekwa okukyuka oba okufa? Nteekwa okukyusibwa oba okusalirwa omusango? Kale kye kiseera nze okwetunuulira, nga tekinnaba kuyitawo. Woowe, lwaki saafaayo ku kino okutuusa kaakano? Lwaki nnalagajjala ne nsindiikiriza ensonga ennene bweti? Nnali muzuukufu, oba nnali mu magezi gange? Woowe Katonda Omutendereze, kisa kyenkana ki nti tewasala bulamu bwange mu kiseera kino kyonna, nga sinnaba kufuna ssuubi lyonna erikakafu ery’obulamu obutaggwaawo!—Kale, Katonda aleme kuleka nze okulagajjalira omulimu guno nate. Emmeeme yange eri mu mbeera ki? Nkyuse, oba sikyuse? Enkyukakyuka oba omulimu ng’ogwo gwali gukoleddwako emmeeme yange? Nnamulisiddwa ekigambo n’Omwoyo wa Mukama okulaba obubi bw’ekibi obwenyinyaza, obwetaavu bw’Omulokozi, okwagala kwa Kristo, n’obulungi bwa Katonda n’ekitiibwa? Omutima gwange gumenyese oba gwetoowazizza munda yange olw’obulamu bwange obw’edda? Nnaniriza n’okwebaza Omulokozi wange era Mukama wange eyeewaayo n’okusonyiyibwa n’obulamu olw’emmeeme yange? Nkyawa obulamu bwange obw’edda obw’ekibi, n’ekisigaddewo ku buli kibi ekiri mu nze? Mbiddukako ng’abalabe bange abatta? Nneewaayo eri obulamu obw’obutukuvu n’obuwulize eri Katonda? Mbwagala era mbusanyukiramu? Nsobola okwogera mu mazima nti nnafa eri ensi n’okwerowoozaako okw’omubiri, era nti mbeera mulamu ku lwa Katonda, n’ekitiibwa kye yasuubiza? Eggulu lye nsinga okutwala nga ery’omuwendo era lye nsinga okumalirira okusinga ensi? era Katonda y’asinga okuba omwagalwa era ow’oku ntikko mu mmeeme yange? Edda, nkimanyi bulungi, nnabeeranga mulamu okusinga ku lw’ensi n’omubiri, era Katonda teyalina kirala wabula obuweereza obumu obutaliimu mutima ensi bwe yasobolanga okwerekereza, era obwali ebisigalira by’omubiri.—Omutima gwange kaakano gukyuse ne gutunula eruuyi olulala? Nnina ekigendererwa ekiggya, n’enkomerero empya, n’okwegomba okutukuvu okuggya? Essuubi lyange n’omutima gwange mbitadde mu ggulu? Era ekigendererwa, n’enteekateeka, n’okwegomba kw’omutima gwange n’obulamu bwange si kwe kutuuka obulungi mu ggulu, ne ndaba amaaso ga Katonda ag’ekitiibwa, ne mbeera mu kwagala kwe n’okumutendereza emirembe gyonna? Era bwe nnyonoona, kiba kikontana n’okwegomba okwa bulijjo n’ekigendererwa ky’omutima gwange? Era mpangula ebibi byonna eby’olwatu, era nkooye obunafu bwange era njagala okubuwona? Eno y’embeera y’emmeeme ekyuse, era bwe kiteekwa okuba gye ndi bwe kityo, oba nteekwa okuzikirira. Ddala bwe kiri gye ndi bwe kityo, oba si bwe kiri? Kye kiseera okugonjoola okubuusabuusa kuno, ng’omulamuzi ow’entiisa tannakugonjoola. Siri mugwira nnyo eri omutima gwange n’obulamu bwange, nga sisobola kutegeerako katono oba nkyuse bwe ntyo oba sikyuse: bwe mba nga sikyuse, tekiriiko kye kinangasa okuwaanawaana emmeeme yange n’endowooza ez’obulimba n’essuubi ery’obulimba. Mmaliridde obutaddamu kwerimba, wabula okufuba okumanya mu mazima, mu ngeri yonna, oba nkyuse, yee oba nedda: bwe mba nga nkyuse, nsanyuke olw’ekyo; ngulumize Mukama wange ow’ekisa, era neeyongereyo n’emirembe okutuusa lwe ndituuka ku ngule: Era bwe mba nga sikyuse, nteeke omwoyo ku kusaba n’okunoonya ekisa ekyandinkyusizza, era nkyuke awatali kulwawo kwonna nate:—Kubanga, bwe nnaakizuula nga bukyali nti ndi bweru wa kkubo, olw’obuyambi bwa Kristo nsobola okukyuka ne nzzibwawo; naye bwe nnaalinda okutuusa omutima gwange lwe gulirekebwa Katonda, mu buzibe oba mu bukakanyavu, oba okutuusa lwe ndiwambibwa okufa, olwo kiriba kiyiseeko. Mu kiseera ekyo tewaliba kifo kya kwenenya na kukyuka: Nkimanyi nti kiteekwa kuba kaakano oba tekiribaawo.”

Abange, kino kye mbasaba, nti mukebere emitima gyammwe, era mugigezese bwe mutyo, okutuusa lwe munaalaba, bwe kiba kisoboka, oba mukyuse oba temukyuse; era bwe munaaba nga temusobola kukizuula ku lwammwe, mugende eri abaweereza bammwe, bwe baba abantu abeesigwa era abalina obumanyirivu, mubasabe babayambe. Ensonga nkulu, ensonyi oba obulagajjavu bireme kubaziyiza. Baabateekebwako okubawabula, olw’okulokola emmeeme zammwe, ng’abasawo bwe babawabula olw’okuwonya emibiri gyammwe. Kizikiriza enkumi n’enkumi, nti balowooza nti bali mu kkubo ery’obulokozi so nga tebaliimu; era nga balowooza nti bakyuse, so nga si bwe kiri. Olwo, bwe tubakoowoola okukyuka, ne bagenda nga bwe bajja, ne balowooza nti kino tekibakwatako; kubanga baakyuka dda, era basuubira nti banaakola bulungi ekimala mu kkubo lye balimu; naddala bwe balonda obulonzi ekkubo erisinga obulungi, ne beewala ebigere ebimu ebisinga obubi; so nga, woowe! mu kiseera kino kyonna babeera balamu ku lw’ensi n’omubiri bwokka, era bagwira eri Katonda n’obulamu obutaggwaawo, era bali bweru ddala w’ekkubo erigenda mu ggulu. Era kino kyonna okusinga kiva ku kuba nti tetusobola kubasendasenda kulowooza katono mu bwesimbu ku mbeera yaabwe, n’okumala essaawa ntono nga bakebera embeera zaabwe. Tewali bangi ku bannaku abeerimba abampulira leero, abatawaayo wadde essaawa emu mu bulamu bwabwe bwonna okukebera emmeeme zaabwe, n’okugezesa oba ddala bakyuse oba tebakyuse?—Woowe Katonda omusaasizi, alifaayo ku bannaku ng’abo abatafaayo ku bo bennyini kusingawo, era alikola ebingi bwe bityo okubalokola okuva mu ggeyeena, n’okubayamba okutuuka mu ggulu, so nga bo bennyini tebalikolera kino kitono! Singa abo bonna abali mu kkubo erigenda mu ggeyeena baali bakimanyi, tebandyaŋŋanze kweyongera kulibeeramu. Essuubi Setaani ly’asinga okuba nalyo ery’okubatwala mu kuzikirira nga tewali abanunula, kwe kubakuuma nga muzibiddwa amaaso era nga temumanyi mbeera yammwe, n’okubakkirizisa nti muyinza okukola obulungi ekimala mu kkubo lye mulimu. Singa mwali mumanyi nti muli bweru wa kkubo erigenda mu ggulu, era nga mulibula emirembe gyonna singa mufa nga bwe muli; mwandyaŋŋanze okwebaka ekiro ekirala mu mbeera gye mulimu? mwandyaŋŋanze okumala olunaku olulala nga mugirimu? Mwandisobodde okuseka okuva ku mutima oba okusanyuka mu mbeera ng’eyo? Kiki! nga temumanyi nti muyinza okuwambibwa ne mutwalibwa mu ggeyeena mu ssaawa emu! Mazima kyandibawalirizza okuleka ab’emikwano bammwe ab’edda n’empisa zammwe ne mwewaayo mu makubo ag’obutukuvu n’okussa ekimu n’abatukuvu: Mazima kyandibagobye okukaabirira Katonda abawe omutima omuggya, n’okunoonya obuyambi okuva eri abo abasaanira okubawabula. Mazima tewali n’omu ku mmwe atafaayo ku kuzikirizibwa. Kale nno, mbeegayiridde mukebere amangu ddala emitima gyammwe, era temugiwa kiwummulo okutuusa lwe munaazuula embeera yammwe; bw’eba nnungi, musanyuke olw’ekyo, era mweyongereyo; era bw’eba mbi, mwetunuulire amangu ddala okufuna okuwona, ng’abantu abakkiriza nti bateekwa okukyuka oba okufa. Mugamba mutya, Abange? Munaamalirira, era ne musuubiza, okufuba okwenkana awo ku lw’emmeeme zammwe? Munaatandika okwekebera kuno bwe munaatuuka awaka? Kye mbasaba tekiriimu nsonga? Emyoyo gyammwe egy’omunda gimanyi nti kiriimu.—Kale mukimalirire, nga temunnava wano; nga mumanyi nga bwe kikwata nnyo ku mmeeme zammwe. Mbeegayiridde, ku lwa Katonda oyo abalagira, gwe mwenna mujja okulabikako mu maaso ge ku ntebe ye ey’okusala emisango mu bbanga ttono, temungaana kino kye mbasaba eky’amagezi: ku lw’emmeeme ezirina okukyuka oba okufa, mbeegayiridde temungaana; wabula mufuule kye mukola okutegeera embeera zammwe, ne muzimba ku musingi omugumu, ne mumanya, mu ngeri yonna, oba mukyuse oba temukyuse, ne mutateeka mmeeme zammwe mu kabi olw’okwekakasa okw’obulagajjavu.

fields.title: Okubuulira II
fields.body_html:
Ezeekyeri 33:11.

Bategeeze nti, ‘Nga bwe ndi omulamu, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda, sisanyukira kufa kw’abakozi ba bibi, wabula bo okukyuka ne bava mu kkubo lyabwe ebbi ne baba balamu. Mukyuke, mukyuke okuva mu makubo gammwe amabi. Lwaki mufa, mmwe ennyumba ya Isirayiri?’

EBY’AMAZIMA ebinnyonnyola abo abali mu mbeera y’abakyuse mwabiweebwa dda; n’enkyukakyuka okukyuka gye kuleeta mu mmeeme nayo yannyonnyoddwa; era mbeegayirira nate n’omutima gwonna, mwekenneenye embeera yammwe awatali kwekubiira era mu bujjuvu: Temumatira okutuusa lwe mutegeera obanga ddala mukyuse.

Naye oboolyawo mujja kugamba nti, kale bwe tunaasanga nga tukyali tetukyuse, tunaakola ki olwo?—Ekibuuzo kino kintwala ku njigiriza yange ey’okubiri, ejja okuyamba ennyo okukiddamu, era kaakano ngigendako.

Enjigiriza 2. Katonda yasuubiza nti abakozi b’ebibi baliba balamu, singa bakyuka bukyusi; ne bakyuka mu mazima awatali bunnanfuusi era mu bujjuvu.

Mukama wano ayatula nti kino kye kimusanyusa, abakozi b’ebibi okukyuka ne baba balamu. Eggulu likakafu eri abakyuse nga ggeyeena bw’ekakafu eri abatakyuse. Kyuka obeere mulamu, ge mazima amakakafu nga bwe gali amazima nti kyuka oba ofe. Katonda teyali wa buvunaanyizibwa kututeekerateekera Mulokozi, newakubadde okutuggulirawo oluggi lw’essuubi, newakubadde okutuyita okwenenya n’okukyuka nga tumaze okwesuula olw’ekibi; naye yakikola ku bwereere okugulumiza okusaasira kwe. Mmwe aboonoonyi, tewali n’omu ku mmwe aliba n’ensonga okuddayo eka n’agamba nti mbabuulira kuggwaamu ssuubi. Ffe tulina empisa ey’okubaggalira oluggi lw’okusaasira? Ayi, singa nammwe temuluggalira mwekka! Tulina empisa ey’okubagamba nti Katonda talibasaasira, ne bwe mukyuka ne mutukuzibwa? Ddi lwe mwali muwulidde omubuulizi ng’ayogera ekigambo ng’ekyo? Mmwe ababoggolera ababuulizi b’Enjiri, olw’okwagala okubawonya ggeyeena, ne mugamba nti babuulira kuggwaamu ssuubi, mumbuulire, bwe muba musobola, ddi lwe mwali muwulidde omuntu yenna ow’amagezi amatebenkevu ng’agamba nti temulina ssuubi, ne bwe mwenenya ne mukyuka? Nedda, ffe tulangirira ekikontana n’ekyo okuva eri Mukama; nti buli azaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, era olw’okukkiriza n’okwenenya n’afuuka ekitonde ekiggya, talirema kulokolebwa: Era tuli wala nnyo okubasendasenda okuggwaamu essuubi ku kino, kubanga tubasendasenda obutakibuusabuusa n’akatono. Bulamu, so si kufa, kye kitundu ekisooka eky’obubaka bwaffe gye muli; omulimu gwe twakwasibwa kwe kubawa obulokozi, obulokozi obukakafu; obulokozi obw’amangu, obw’ekitiibwa, obutaggwaawo, eri buli omu ku mmwe; eri omusabirizi asinga obwavu era n’eri omwami asinga obukulu; eri asinga obubi mu mmwe, n’eri abatamiivu, abalayira obwereere, ab’ensi, ababbi, weewaawo, n’eri abanyooma n’abavuma ekkubo ettukuvu ery’obulokozi. Mukama, mukama waffe, atulagidde okubawa okusonyiyibwa kw’ebyo byonna ebyayita, bwe munaakomawo kaakano ku nkomerero ne muba balamu: atulagidde okubeegayirira n’okubasaba mukkirize ekyo kye mubawa mukomewo; okubabuulira byonna Kristo bye yateekateeka; okusaasira okubalindiridde, okugumiikiriza okubalindirira, ebirowoozo eby’ekisa Katonda by’alina gye muli, n’essanyu lye muyinza okuba nalyo, essanyu erikakafu era eritayogerekeka, singa mwagala.—Mazima tulina n’obubaka obw’obusungu n’okufa, weewaawo, obw’obusungu n’okufa ebya mirundi ebiri; naye tewali na kimu ku byo bwe bubaka bwaffe obukulu; tuteekwa okubabuulira ku busungu obubali ku mutwe kaakano, n’okufa kwe mwazaalibwamu, olw’okumenya etteeka ly’ebikolwa; naye kino kuba kubalaga bulazi nti mwetaaga okusaasirwa, n’okubakubiriza okutwala ekisa ky’Omununuzi nga kya muwendo. Era tetubabuulira kirala wabula amazima, ge muteekwa okumanya: Kubanga ani anoonya eddagala, atamanyi nti mulwadde? Okubabuulira ku nnaku yammwe si kye kibafuula abanaku, wabula kibagoba ne mugenda okunoonya okusaasirwa. Mmwe mwennyini mwe mwereetedde okufa kuno. Era tubabuulira ne ku kufa okulala; okutalina ddagala, era okubonaabona okusinga ennyo, okulituuka ku abo abagaana okukyuka. Naye, nga kino bwe kiri eky’amazima, era kiteekwa okubabuulirwa, bwe kityo kye kitundu eky’enkomerero era ekisinga obunaku eky’obubaka bwaffe. Tusooka kubawa kusaasirwa bwe munaakyuka; era abo bokka abagaana okukyuka, era abagaana okuwulira eddoboozi ly’okusaasira, be tuteekwa okulagula okuzikirira. Mwesuuleko bwesuuzi ebyonoono byammwe, temulwawo nate, wabula mujje nga Kristo abayise, mukyuke, mufuuke ebitonde ebiggya, olwo tetulina kigambo na kimu kya busungu obuzikiriza oba okufa eky’okwogera ku mmwe.—Kaakano mu linnya lya Mukama ow’obulamu, mbalangirira mmwe mwenna abampulira leero, n’eri asinga obukulu, n’eri omwonoonyi asinga obukadde, nti muyinza okufuna okusaasirwa n’obulokozi, singa mukyuka bukyusi. Mu Katonda mulimu okusaasira, mu kutangirira kwa Kristo mulimu ekimala, ekisuubizo kya bwereere, kijjuvu era kya bonna; muyinza okufuna obulamu, singa mukyuka bukyusi. Naye olwo, nga bwe mwagala emmeeme zammwe, mujjukire okukyuka Ebyawandiikibwa kwe byogerako. Si kuddaabiriza nnyumba nkadde, wabula kumenya byonna, n’okuzimba obuggya ku Kristo, olwazi era omusingi omunywevu. Si kulongoosaako katono mu bulamu obw’omubiri, wabula kutta omubiri, n’okutambulira mu mwoyo. Si kuweereza mubiri n’ensi mu ngeri erongooseddwamu, nga temuli bibi bya buswavu ebyesittaza, era nga mulimu ekika ky’eddiini; wabula kukyusa mukama wammwe, n’emirimu gyammwe, n’ekigendererwa kyammwe, n’okukyusa amaaso gammwe okutunula ku luuyi olulala, n’okukola byonna olw’obulamu bwe mutalabangako, n’okwewaayo mwennyini ne byonna bye mulina eri Katonda. Eno y’enkyukakyuka eteekwa okubaawo, bwe muba mwagala okuba abalamu.

Mmwe mwennyini muli bajulirwa kaakano, nti obulokozi, so si kuzikirira, y’enjigiriza enkulu gye mbabuulira, era kye kitundu ekisooka eky’obubaka bwange gye muli. Mukkirize kino, era tetujja kweyongerayo nammwe; kubanga tetwandyagadde n’akatono kubatiisa oba kubateganya n’erinnya ly’okuzikirira awatali nsonga.

Naye bwe muba temwagala kulokolebwa, tewali kya kukola, okuzikirira kuteekwa okubaawo; kubanga wakati w’ebibiri bino tewali kifo kya wakati, muteekwa okufuna obulamu oba okufa.

Era tetulina kubawa bulamu bwokka, wabula n’okubalaga emisingi kwe tukikolera; n’okubayita okukkiriza nti Katonda ddala ategeeza ky’ayogera: nti ekisuubizo kya mazima, era kituuka ku mmwe ku bukwakkulizo, nga bwe kituuka ku balala: era nti eggulu si kirooto, wabula ssanyu lya mazima.

Bwe mubuuza nti, Obuyinza obw’okubawa kino buli ludda wa? Mu bitundu by’Ebyawandiikibwa ebisukka mu kikumi, nja kububalaga mu bino ebitono:

Okusooka, mukiraba wano mu kyawandiikibwa kyange, ne mu nnyiriri eziddako, ne mu ssuula ey’e 18 eya Ezeekyeri, nga kyeyolefu nga bwe kiyinza okwogerwa. Ne mu 2 Abakkolinso 5:17-21, mulimu ensonga enkulu ey’omulimu gwe twakwasibwa. “Noolwekyo omuntu yenna bw’abeera mu Kristo, aba kitonde kiggya; eby’edda nga bigenze, laba ng’afuuse muggya. Ebintu byonna biva eri Katonda eyatukomyawo gy’ali nga tuyita mu Kristo, era ne tuweebwa obuweereza obw’okutabaganya. Kubanga Katonda yali mu Kristo, ng’atabagana n’abantu, nga tababalira, bibi byabwe, n’atuteresa ffe obubaka obw’okutabaganya. Noolwekyo ku bwa Kristo tuli babaka, era Katonda atuma ffe okwogera nammwe. Kyetuva tubeegayirira, ku bwa Kristo, mutabagane ne Katonda. Kubanga oyo ataamanya kibi, yafuuka ekibi ku lwaffe, tulyoke tufune obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda mu Yesu.” Bwe kityo ne mu Makko 16:15, 16. “Mugende mu nsi yonna mubuulire Enjiri eri abantu bonna. Abo bonna abakkiriza, (kwe kugamba, n’okukkiriza okukyusa omuntu ng’okwo okwogeddwako) ne babatizibwa balirokolebwa, naye abo abatakkiriza balisalirwa omusango ne gubasinga.” Ne Lukka 24:46, 47. “Kristo kimugwanira okubonaabona, n’okufa era ku lunaku olwokusatu azuukire mu bafu. Era mu linnya lye Enjiri ey’okwenenya, (kwe kukyuka) n’okusonyiyibwa ebibi eribuulirwa amawanga gonna.” Ne Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:30, 31. “Katonda wa bajjajjaffe yazuukiza Yesu, gwe mwatta nga mumuwanise ku muti. Oyo Katonda n’amugulumiza okubeera Omulangira era Omulokozi, abeerenga ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo, okuwa Isirayiri omukisa ogw’okwenenya n’okusonyiyibwa ebibi.” Ne Ebikolwa by’Abatume 13:38, 39. “Abooluganda, mumpulirize! Mu muntu ono Yesu okusonyiyibwa ebibi mwe kubuuliddwa. Kino nga tekiyinzika mu mateeka ga Musa. Buli amukkiriza n’amwesiga aggyibwako omusango gw’ekibi, n’aweebwa obutuukirivu.” Era, muleme okulowooza nti ekirabo kino kyakomezebwa ku Bayudaaya bokka, mulabe Abaggalatiya 6:15. “Kubanga okukomolebwa oba obutakomolebwa si kintu, wabula ekikulu kye kitonde ekiggya.” Ne Lukka 14:17. “Mujje byonna biwedde okutegeka.” n’ennyiriri 23, 24.

Kaakano mulaba nti tulagiddwa okubawa mwenna obulamu, n’okubabuulira, okuva eri Katonda, nti bwe munaakyuka, muyinza okuba abalamu.

Wano muyinza okwesiga emmeeme zammwe awatali kutya; kubanga okwagala kwa Katonda ye nsulo y’ekirabo kino, (Yokaana 3:16), era omusaayi gw’Omwana wa Katonda gwe gwakigula: Obwesigwa n’amazima ga Katonda byeyamye okutuukiriza ekisuubizo; eby’amagero byakakasa amazima gaakyo; ababuulizi batumibwa mu nsi yonna okukirangirira; amasakramentu gaateekebwawo era gakozesebwa okukwasa mu kitiibwa okusaasira okuweebwa abo abakkiriza okukufuna; n’Omwoyo aggulawo omutima okukwaniriza; era ye musingo ogw’okukifuna mu bujjuvu: N’olwekyo amazima gaakyo tegakyalina kuwakanyizibwa, nti asinga obubi mu mmwe mwenna, na buli omu ku mmwe, singa mukyuka bukyusi, muyinza okulokolebwa.

Mazima, bwe muba mumaliridde okukkiriza nti mulirokolebwa nga temukyuse, olwo mukkiriza bulimba; era, singa mbabuulira ekyo, nandibadde mbuulira bulimba: Ekyo tekyandibadde kukkiriza Katonda, wabula Setaani n’emitima gyammwe egy’obulimba.—Katonda alina ekisuubizo kye eky’obulamu, ne Setaani alina ekisuubizo kye eky’obulamu: Ekisuubizo kya Katonda kiri nti, “mukyuke mube balamu:” Ekisuubizo kya Setaani kiri nti, “mujja kuba balamu, ne bwe mukyuka oba nedda.”—Ekigambo kya Katonda kiri nti, nga bwe mbalaze, “bwe mutakyuke kufaanana ng’abaana abato temugenda kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.” (Matayo 18:3). “Omuntu bw’atazaalibwa mulundi gwakubiri tayinza kulaba bwakabaka bwa Katonda.” (Yokaana 3:3, 5). “atali mutukuvu taliraba Mukama.” (Abaebbulaniya 12:14).—Ekigambo kya Setaani kiri nti, “muyinza okulokolebwa nga temuzaaliddwa mulundi gwakubiri era nga temukyuse; muyinza okuba obulungi nga temuli batukuvu; Katonda abatiisatiisa butiisa; wa kisa nnyo okukola nga bw’ayogera; alibakolera ebisinga ku kigambo kye.”—Era, zisanze! ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky’ensi kikkiriza ekigambo kino ekya Setaani okusinga ekigambo kya Katonda: nga ekibi kyaffe n’ennaku yaffe bwe byayingira mu nsi. Katonda yagamba bazadde baffe abaasooka nti, “lw’oligulyako tolirema kufa.” Setaani n’amuwakanya n’agamba nti, “Temugenda kufa, bwe munaakaaba bukaabi ku nkomerero nti, Katonda tusaasire, ne mulekayo ebikolwa by’ekibi nga temukyasobola kubikola.” Era kino kye kigambo ensi ky’ekkiriza.—Ayi obubi obw’ekivve, okukkiriza Setaani okusinga Katonda!

Naye ekyo si kye kisinga obubi; kubanga mu kuvvoola bakiyita kukkiriza n’okwesiga Katonda, nga bamufaananya Setaani, eyali omulimba okuva ku lubereberye. Era bwe bakkiriza nti ekigambo kya Katonda bulimba, bakiyita kwesiga Katonda, ne bagamba nti bamukkiriza era nti bamwesiga okubalokola. Katonda yali ayogedde wa nti abatazaalibwanga mulundi gwakubiri, abatakyuse, abatatukuziddwa, balirokolebwa? Mundage ekigambo ng’ekyo mu Byawandiikibwa. Mbasoomooza, bwe muba musobola. Lwaki, kino kigambo kya Setaani, era okukikkiriza kwe kukkiriza Setaani, era kye kibi ekitera okuyitibwa okwetulinkiriza. Era kino mukiyita kukkiriza n’okwesiga Katonda? Mu kigambo kya Katonda mulimu buli kimu ekibudaabuda n’okunyweza emitima gy’abatukuziddwa: naye tewali kigambo na kimu ekinyweza emikono gy’obubi, newakubadde okuwa abantu essuubi erisinga obutono ery’okulokolebwa, nga tebatukuzibwanga n’akatono.

Naye bwe munaakyuka, ne muyingira mu kkubo ly’okusaasira, okusaasira kwa Mukama kweteeseteese okubaaniriza. Olwo mwesige Katonda okubalokola n’obuvumu; kubanga yeeyama mu kigambo kye okubalokola. Taliba kitaawe w’omuntu yenna okuggyako abaana be, era talirokola muntu yenna okuggyako abo abaleka ensi, Setaani, n’omubiri, ne bayingira mu maka ge okuba ebitundu by’Omwana we, n’okussa ekimu n’abatukuvu be. Naye bwe bagaana okuyingira, ensobi yaabwe bo. Enzigi ze nzigule, taziyiza muntu yenna. Teyatumangako bubaka nga buno eri omuntu yenna ku mmwe nti, “Kaakano kikeerezi nnyo; sijja kukwaniriza ne bw’onookyuka.”—Yandikoze bw’atyo, era nga tabakoze kibi: Naye teyakikola; era takikola n’okutuusa leero: Akyali mwetegefu okubaaniriza, singa mubadde beetegefu, mu mazima awatali bunnanfuusi, n’emitima gyammwe gyonna, okukyuka. Era obujjuvu bw’amazima gano bujja kweyongera okweyoleka mu njigiriza ebbiri eziddako, kye nnaava nzigendako, nga sinnaba kweyongera kukozesa kino.

Enjigiriza 3. Katonda asanyukira abantu okukyuka n’okulokolebwa, naye tasanyukira kufa kwabwe oba kuzikirira kwabwe: Asinga kwagala bakyuke babe balamu, okusinga okugenda mu maaso ne bafa.

Nja kusooka kubayigiriza engeri y’okutegeeramu kino, olwo ndyoke mbannyonnyole amazima gaakyo.

Era, ku kisooka, muteekwa okwetegereza ebintu bino wammanga.

1. Okwagala okwangu, oba okusanyukira ekintu, kye kikolwa ekisooka eky’okwagala, nga kiddirira okutegeera okwangu okw’ekyo ekirowoozebwako, nga tekinnatuuka ku kugeraageranya bintu wamu. Naye ekikolwa eky’okwagala ekirondawo kiddirira, era kyesigama ku kikolwa ky’okutegeera ekigeraageranya ebintu mu nkola. Era ebikolwa bino ebibiri bisobola emirundi mingi okwolekera ebintu ebikontana nga tewali kibi kyonna mu muntu oyo.

2. Okwagala okutaliimu bunnanfuusi kuyinza okuba n’amadaala ag’enjawulo. Ebintu ebimu mbyagala nnyo okutuuka n’okukola byonna bye nsobola okubituukiriza: n’ebintu ebimu njagala mu mazima omulala abikole, kyokka nga sijja kukola byonna bye nsobola okubituukiriza, kubanga nnina ensonga nnyingi ezinziyiza, newakubadde ng’ekyo kyonna ekinsaanira okukola nja kukikola.

3. Okwagala kw’omufuzi, nga mufuzi, kweyolekera mu kuteekawo amateeka n’okugatuukiriza; naye okwagala kw’omuntu, mu mbeera ye ey’obuntu obwangu, oba nga nannyini by’alina mu bujjuvu, kweyolekera mu kwegomba oba mu kusalawo ebiribaawo.

4. Okwagala kw’omufuzi, ng’omuteesi w’amateeka, okusooka era okusinga byonna, kwe kuba nti amateeka ge gagonderwa, so si n’akatono nti ekibonerezo kituukibwe ku muntu yenna, okuggyako nga kirowoozebwa nti tebajja kugondera mateeka ge. Naye okwagala kw’omufuzi, ng’omulamuzi, kulowooza nti etteeka lyakuumibwa dda oba lyamenyebwa; n’olwekyo asalawo empeera oba ebibonerezo okusinziira ku ekyo.

Bwe mmaze okuwa enjawulo zino ezeetaagisa, kaakano nja kuzikozesa ku nsonga eri mu maaso gaffe mu bigambo bino wammanga.

1. Mu ndabirwamu y’ekigambo n’ebitonde mwe tuteekwa okumanyira Katonda mu bulamu buno; era bwe kityo, okusinziira ku buzaaliranwa bw’omuntu, tumuwa okutegeera n’okwagala, nga tuggyako obutali butuukirivu bwonna bwe tusobola, kubanga tetusobola kufuna birowoozo bisingako ebituufu ku ye.

2. Era, ku misingi gye gimu, (nga tugoberera Ebyawandiikibwa) twawula wakati w’ebikolwa by’okwagala kwa Katonda, nga byawukana olw’ensonga oba olw’ebintu bye bikwatako, newakubadde nga mu buzaaliranwa bwa Katonda byonna kimu.

3. Era kino tukikola n’obuvumu obusingawo, kubanga bwe twogera ku Kristo, tulina ensonga esingawo okuva mu buzaaliranwa bw’obuntu.

4. Era bwe kityo tugamba nti okusanyukira okwangu, okwagala, oba omukwano gwa Katonda, kutuuka ku buli kirungi mu buzaaliranwa oba mu mpisa, okusinziira ku kika n’obungi bw’obulungi bwakyo. Era bwe kityo asanyukira okukyuka n’okulokolebwa kwa bonna, ekyo kyokka ekitalituukirira.

5. Era Katonda, ng’omufuzi era omuteesi w’amateeka g’ensi, alina okwagala okw’ebikolwa ku lw’obulokozi bwabwe, okutuuka n’okubawa ku bwereere ekirabo kya Kristo n’obulamu, n’okulangirira okusonyiyibwa kw’ebibi byabwe byonna, singa tebakigaana mu butasiima, n’okulagira ababaka be okutwala ekirabo kino eri ensi yonna, n’okubasendasenda okukikkiriza. Era bwe kityo akola byonna ebimusaanira okukola, ng’omuteesi w’amateeka oba ng’oyo asuubiza, ku lw’obulokozi bwabwe.

6. Naye era asalawo, ng’omuteesi w’amateeka, nti abo abagaana okukyuka balifa: Era, ng’omulamuzi, olunaku lwabwe olw’ekisa bwe luliyita, alituukiriza ekiragiro ekyo.

7. N’olwekyo, mu ngeri eno ayagala mu mazima awatali bunnanfuusi okukyuka kw’abo abatalikyuka; naye si nga nannyini byonna ow’obuyinza obutaliiko kkomo, n’okumalirira okusingira ddala okukola, era si ng’ekintu ky’asalawo nti kiteekwa okutuukirira awatali kubuusabuusa, oba ky’ayinza okussaako obuyinza bwe bwonna okukituukiriza. Kiri mu buyinza bw’omulangira okuteeka abakuumi ku mutemu, abakuume aleme okutta n’okuwanikibwa: Naye, bw’alekayo ekyo olw’ensonga ennungi, n’atuma butumi eri abantu be, n’abalabula era n’abeegayirira baleme kuba batemu, nsuubira nti ayinza okugamba obulungi nti tayagala batte bawanikibwe: Takisanyukira, wabula ayagala bakyewale babe balamu: Era, bw’akolera abamu ebisingawo, olw’ensonga ezenjawulo, tasangibwa ng’akolera bonna bw’atyo. Kabaka ayinza okugamba obulungi abatemu bonna n’abamenyi b’amateeka mu nsi nti, “Sisanyukira kufa kwammwe, wabula njagala mugondere amateeka gange mube balamu: Naye bwe munaagaana, nsazeewo, wadde nga byonna bino biriwo, nti mujja kufa.”—Omulamuzi ayinza okugamba mu mazima omubbi oba omutemu nti, “Zisanze, ggwe omuntu, sisanyukira kufa kwo: Nandyagadde wandikuumye etteeka n’owonya obulamu bwo: naye kubanga tolikuumye, nteekwa okukusalira omusango, oba si ekyo nandibadde atali mwenkanya.” Bwe kityo, newakubadde nga Katonda tasanyukira kuzikirira kwammwe, era n’olwekyo abakoowoola mukomewo mube balamu; naye asanyukira okulaga obwenkanya bwe, n’okutuukiriza amateeka ge; era n’olwekyo, wadde nga byonna bino biriwo, amaliridde ddala nti, bwe mutaakyuke, mulisalirwa omusango. Singa Katonda yali awakanya nnyo okufa kw’abakozi b’ebibi okutuuka n’okumalirira okukola kyonna ky’asobola okukuziyiza, olwo tewandibaddewo muntu n’omu asalirwa musango; kyokka Kristo abagamba nti batono abalirokolebwa. Naye Katonda awakanya okuzikirira kwammwe okutuuka n’okubayigiriza n’okubalabula, n’okussa mu maaso gammwe obulamu n’okufa, n’okubawa eddembe okulonda, n’okulagira abaweereza be okubeegayirira muleme okwezikiriza, wabula mukkirize okusaasira kwe, bwe kityo n’abaleka nga temulina kya kwewolereza. Naye, kino bwe kitaakole, era bwe mubeera nga mukyali temukyuse, abategeeza nti amaliridde okubazikiriza, era atulagidde okubagamba mu linnya lye, (olunyiriri 8), “Ggwe omwonoonyi, mazima olifa!” Era Kristo kumpi akirayidde emirundi n’emirundi, ng’agamba nti, “Ddala ddala, bwe mutaakyuke, ne muzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, temugenda kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu” (Matayo 18:3; Yokaana 3:3). Mutegeere nti yagamba nti, temuyinza. Kya bwereere okukisuubira, era kya bwereere okuloota nti Katonda akyagala, kubanga kintu ekitasoboka.

Mu bufunze, kaakano mulaba amakulu g’ekyawandiikibwa kino, nti Katonda, omuteesi w’amateeka omukulu ow’ensi, tasanyukira kufa kw’abakozi b’ebibi, wabula ayagala bakyuke babe balamu; newakubadde ng’amaliridde nti tewali aliba omulamu okuggyako abo abakyuka, era, ng’omulamuzi, asanyukira obwenkanya, n’okulaga obukyayi bwe eri ekibi, wadde nga tasanyukira nnaku gye beereetedde bo bennyini, bw’etunuulirwa yokka.

2. Era ku bukakafu bw’ensonga eno, nja kuba mumpi nnyo, kubanga ndowooza nti mukikkiriza dda awatali buzibu.

1. Obuzaaliranwa bwa Katonda obw’ekisa ekingi, obwalangirirwa (Okuva 34:6; 20:6) ne mu bifo ebirala emirundi mingi, buyinza okubakakasa kino, nti tasanyukira kufa kwammwe.

2. Singa Katonda yali asanyukira okufa kwo okusinga okukyuka kwo n’obulamu bwo, teyandikulagidde emirundi mingi bwe kityo mu kigambo kye, okukyuka; teyandikuwadde bisuubizo bya bulamu ng’ebyo, singa okyuka bukyusi; teyandikusendasenze okukikola n’ensonga nnyingi bwe zityo. Enkola y’Enjiri ye yennyini ekakasa ensonga eno.

3. Era omulimu gwe yakwasa abaweereza b’Enjiri gukikakasiza ddala. Singa Katonda yali asanyukira okuzikirira kwammwe okusinga okukyuka kwammwe n’okulokolebwa kwammwe, teyanditulagidde n’akatono okubawa okusaasira, n’okubayigiriza ekkubo ly’obulamu, mu lwatu ne mu kyama; n’okubeegayirira n’okubasaba mukyuke mube balamu; okubategeeza ebibi byammwe, n’okubalabula ku kabi kammwe, n’okukola byonna bye tusobola okubakyusa, n’okugenda mu maaso n’okukola bwe tutyo n’obugumiikiriza, ne bwe munaatukyawa oba okutuyisa obubi olw’okufuba kwaffe. Katonda yandikoze kino, n’ateekawo ebiragiro bye eby’okusinza olw’obulungi bwammwe, singa yali asanyukira okufa kwammwe?

4. Era kikakasibwa n’enkola y’obuyinza bwe obulabirira ensi. Singa Katonda yali asinga kwagala muzikirire okusinga okukyuka n’okulokolebwa, teyandiwagidde kigambo kye n’ebikolwa bye, n’okubasikiriza eri ye n’ekisa kye eky’olunaku ku lunaku, n’okubawa ebirungi byonna eby’obulamu buno, by’akozesa okubaleeta mu kwenenya, (Abaruumi 2:4), n’okubaleeta emirundi mingi bwe giti wansi w’omuggo gwe okubazza mu magezi gammwe. Teyanditadde mu maaso gammwe ebyokulabirako bingi bwe bityo, nedda, era teyandibalindiridde n’obugumiikiriza nga bw’akola, olunaku ku lunaku, n’omwaka ku mwaka. Bino si bubonero bw’oyo asanyukira okufa kwammwe.—Singa kino kye kyali kimusanyusa, nga yandisobodde mangu nnyo okukuteeka mu ggeyeena edda? Emirundi emeka nga kino tekinnabaawo yandisobodde okukusikula ng’oli wakati mu bibi byo, ng’ekikolimo oba ekirayiro, oba obulimba buli mu kamwa ko, mu butamanya bwo, n’amalala go, n’okwegomba kw’omubiri? Bwe wali omulundi gwo ogusembayo mu butamiivu bwo, oba ng’oli ku mulundi ogusembayo ng’oduulira amakubo ga Katonda, nga yandisobodde mangu nnyo okusiba omukka gwo, n’akufuga n’ebibonyoobonyo bye, n’akufuula omutebenkevu mu nsi endala? Zisanze! nga kintu kitono nnyo eri Ayinzabyonna okufuga olulimi lw’omuvumi asinga obutatya Katonda, n’okusiba emikono gy’omuyigganya asinga ettima, oba okukkakkanya obusungu bw’omulabe we asinga obukyayi, n’okubamanyisa nti tebali kirala wabula envunyu? Singa akusunguwalira, wandigudde mu ntaana yo. Singa awa omu ku bamalayika be obuyinza okugenda okuzikiriza aboonoonyi omutwalo gumu, nga kyandikoleddwa mangu nnyo. Nga asobola mangu okukugalamiza ku kitanda eky’obulwadde, n’akulekayo ng’owowoggana mu bulumi, n’akuleetera okulya ebigambo eby’ekivume bye wayogera ku baweereza be, ku kigambo kye, ku kusinza kwe, ne ku makubo ge amatukuvu, n’akuleetera okutuma okwegayirira abo be wanyoomanga mu kwetulinkiriza kwo bakusabire! Nga asobola mangu okugalamiza omubiri gwo mu kuluma n’okusinda, n’agunafuya ne gulemwa okukwata emmeeme yo, n’agufuula ogw’omuzizo okusinga obusa bw’ensi!—Omubiri ogwo kaakano ogulina okufuna kye gwagala, era ogutateekwa kunyiizibwa newakubadde nga Katonda anyiiziddwa; era ogulina okusanyusibwa mu mmere, mu byokunywa, ne mu byambalo, ne bwe kiba nga Katonda ayogera ebikontana n’ekyo, nga okusunguwala kwa Katonda kwandiguzikirizza mangu nnyo?—Bwe wali ng’olwanirira ekibi kyo n’obusungu, ng’oyomba n’abo abandikuggyeemu, ng’olaga ettima lyo eri akunenya, era ng’owolereza ebikolwa by’ekizikiza; nga Katonda yandisobodde mangu okukusikula mu kaseera akatono, n’akuteeka mu maaso g’Obukulu bwe obw’entiisa, gy’owandirabye bamalayika ab’ekitiibwa emitwalo n’emitwalo nga balindirira ku ntebe ye? n’akuyita eyo okwewolereza, n’akubuuza nti, “Kaakano olina ki eky’okwogera ku Mutonzi wo, ku mazima ge, ku baweereza be, oba ku makubo ge amatukuvu? Kaakano weewolereze, era okole ekisinga obulungi ky’osobola. Kaakano oyinza kwogera ki okwewolereza olw’ebibi byo? Kaakano wa embalirira y’obwensi bwo n’obulamu bwo obw’omubiri, ey’ebiseera byo, n’ey’ebirungi byonna bye wafuna!” Ayi, omutima gwo omukakanyavu nga gwandisaanuuse, n’amaaso go ag’amalala nga gandikkakkanyiziddwa, n’obwenyi bwo nga bwandisiiwuuse, n’ebigambo byo eby’amaanyi nga byandifuuse kusirika awatali kwogera, oba okukaaba okw’entiisa, singa Katonda yali akuyimiriza bw’atyo mu maaso g’entebe ye ey’emisango, n’awoza ensonga ye mu maaso go, gye wawakanya wano n’ettima bwe lityo! Nga asobola mangu ekiseera kyonna okugamba emmeeme yo erina omusango nti, “Jangu, toddayo kubeera mu mubiri ogwo okutuusa ku kuzuukira,” era nga tesobola kugaana! Ekigambo eky’omu kamwa ke kyandiggyawo ekiwanirira obulamu bwo obwa kaakano, olwo ebitundu byo byonna n’amaanyi go byonna ne biyimirira butengerera: Era, bw’akugamba nti, “Lekeraawo okuba omulamu, oba beera mulamu mu ggeyeena,” towandisobodde kujeemera.

Naye Katonda tannakola na kimu ku bino, wabula akugumiikirizza n’obugumiikiriza, era akuwaniridde n’okusaasira, era akuwadde omukka ogwo gwe wassa ng’omuwakanya, era n’akuwa ebirungi ebyo bye wawaayo nga ssaddaaka eri omubiri gwo, era n’akuwa ebyetaago ebyo bye wamalira okumatiza emimiro gyo egy’omululu; yakuwa buli dakiika y’ebiseera ebyo bye wonoona mu bugayaavu, oba mu butamiivu, oba mu by’ensi: era obugumiikiriza bwe bwonna n’okusaasira kwe tebiraga nti teyayagala kuzikirira kwo? Ettaala eyinza okwaka awatali mafuta? Ennyumba zammwe zisobola okuyimirira awatali ttaka okuziwanirira? Bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kuba balamu essaawa emu yokka nga Katonda tabawanirira. Era lwaki yawanirira obulamu bwo okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo, wabula okulaba ddi lw’olijjukira obusirusiru bw’amakubo go, n’okomawo n’oba omulamu? Waliwo omuntu yenna ayinza okuteeka mu bugenderevu eby’okulwanyisa mu mikono gy’omulabe we okumulwanyisa; oba okukwatira ettaala omutemu ng’atta abaana be, oba omuddu omugayaavu azannya oba eyeebaka mu kiseera ekyo? Mazima okulaba obanga ku nkomerero olikomawo n’oba omulamu, kye kyaviirako Katonda okukulindirira ebbanga eddene bwe lityo.

5. Era kyongera okukakasibwa, olw’okubonaabona kw’Omwana we, nti Katonda tasanyukira kufa kw’abakozi b’ebibi. Yandibanunudde okuva mu kufa ku muwendo omunene bwe gutyo? Yandiwuniikirizza bamalayika n’abantu olw’okwetoowaza kwe? Katonda yandibeeredde mu mubiri, n’ajja mu kifaananyi ky’omuddu, n’atwala obuntu n’abugatta n’Obwakatonda mu muntu omu? Era Kristo yandibadde n’obulamu obw’okubonaabona, n’afa okufa okw’ekikolimo ku lw’aboonoonyi, singa yali asinga kusanyukira kufa kwabwe? Kale singa mwamulaba ng’ali bufubi mu kubuulira n’okubawonya, nga bwe mumusanga (Makko 3:21), oba ng’amaze ebbanga eddene ng’asiiba, nga (Matayo 4), oba ng’amaze ekiro kyonna mu kusaba, nga (Lukka 6:12), oba ng’asaba ng’amatondo g’omusaayi gamutonnyako mu kifo ky’entuuyo, nga (Lukka 22:44), oba ng’afa okufa okw’ekikolimo ku musaalaba, ng’afuka emmeeme ye nga ssaddaaka olw’ebibi byaffe: Mwandirowoozezza nti obwo bubonero bw’oyo asanyukira okufa kw’abakozi b’ebibi?

Era temulowooza kukikendeeza nga mugamba nti kyali ku lw’abalonde be bokka: Kubanga ekibi kyo, n’ekibi ky’ensi yonna, kye kyali ku Mununuzi waffe; era ssaddaaka ye n’okutangirira kwe bimala bonna, n’ebibala byakyo biweebwa omu nga bwe biweebwa omulala: naye kya mazima, nti tekyali kigendererwa kya mutima gwe okusonyiwa n’okulokola abo bonna abatandikyuse olw’okukkiriza n’okwenenya. Singa mwamulaba ne mumuwulira ng’akaaba ng’akungubagira embeera y’abantu abajeemu, abatenenya, (Lukka 19:41, 42), oba nga yeemulugunya olw’obukakanyavu bwabwe, nga (Matayo 23:37). “Ggwe Yerusaalemi, ggwe Yerusaalemi, emirundi nga mingi nnyo gye njagadde okukuŋŋaanya abaana bo ng’enkoko bw’ekuŋŋaanya obwana bwayo mu biwaawaatiro byayo, naye n’ogaana.” Oba, singa mwamulaba ne mumuwulira ku musaalaba ng’asabira abamuyigganya, “Kitange, basonyiwe, kubanga kye bakola tebakimanyi.” mwanditebereezezza nti asanyukira okufa kw’abakozi b’ebibi, ne kw’abo abazikirira olw’obutakkiriza bwabwe bwe beeroboza? Kale Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, (si kwagala kwokka, wabula okwagala bwe kutyo) bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza, n’okukkiriza okukola, aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo; ndowooza nti mu kino akakasizza, ng’awakanya ettima ly’abantu ne dayimooni, nti tasanyukira kufa kw’abakozi b’ebibi, wabula ayagala bakyuke babe balamu.

6. Ekisembayo, bino byonna bwe biba nga tebinnabamatiza, mukkirize ekigambo kye ye kennyini, oyo amanyi obulungi okusinga omuntu yenna ebiri mu mutima gwe, oba waakiri mukkirize ekirayiro kye: Naye kino kintwala ku njigiriza ey’okuna.

Enjigiriza 4. Mukama atukakasizza n’ekirayiro kye, nti tasanyukira kufa kw’omukozi w’ebibi, wabula ayagala akyuke abe mulamu; alyoke aleme kuleka muntu na nsonga ya kubuusabuusa mazima gaakyo.

Bwe muba mwaŋŋanga okubuusabuusa ekigambo kye, nsuubira nti temwaŋŋanga kubuusabuusa kirayiro kye. Nga Kristo bwe yalangirira mu butongole nti abatazaalibwanga mulundi gwakubiri n’abatakyuse tebayinza kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, (Matayo 18:3; Yokaana 3:3), bwe kityo Katonda yalayira nti tasanyukira kufa kwabwe, wabula okukyuka kwabwe n’obulamu bwabwe. Era nga Omutume bw’agamba, (Abaebbulaniya 6:13, 16-18), Kubanga tayinza kulayira oyo amusinga, ayogera nti, “Nga bwe ndi omulamu, n’ebirala.” Kubanga ddala abantu balayira oyo abasinga obukulu, era ekirayiro eky’okukakasa gye bali y’enkomerero y’empaka zonna: Katonda bwe yayagala okulaga abasika b’ekisuubizo mu ngeri esingawo nti okuteesa kwe tekukyuka, n’akikakasa n’ekirayiro, nti olw’ebintu bibiri ebitajjulukuka, Katonda mw’atasobola kulimba, “ffe abaddukira gy’ali okutulokola, tusaana okuba abagumu. Essuubi eryo lye linywereza ddala emmeeme zaffe ng’ennanga bw’enyweza eryato.” Omuntu yenna bw’aba nga tasobola kutabaganya mazima gano n’enjigiriza ey’okwawulirwa edda, oba n’okuzikirizibwa ddala kw’abakozi b’ebibi, obwo butamanya bwe ye; talina nsonga esigaddewo ey’okwegaana oba okubuusabuusa olw’ekyo amazima g’ensonga eno; kubanga eno ekakasiddwa n’ekirayiro kya Katonda, n’olwekyo tesaana kunyoolwa okugifuula okukwatagana n’ensonga endala; wabula ensonga ezibuusibwabuusibwa ze zisaana okufuulibwa okukwatagana nayo, era amazima amakakafu gasaana okukkirizibwa nti gakwatagana nayo, newakubadde ng’obwongo bwaffe obutono tebutegeera bulungi kukwatagana okwo.

OKUKOZESA.

Kaakano nkwegayirira, bw’oba ng’oli mwonoonyi atakyuse awulira ebigambo bino, olowooze katono ku njigiriza ezo ezoogeddwako, era weebuuze akaseera nti ani asanyukira ekibi kyo n’okuzikirira kwo! Mazima si Katonda: Yalayira, ku lulwe, nti tasanyukira. Era mmanyi nti si kumusanyusa ky’ogenderera mu ekyo. Toyinza kwaŋŋanga kugamba nti otamiira, olayira, olagajjalira emirimu emitukuvu, era ozikiza okukubiriza kw’Omwoyo, olw’okusanyusa Katonda. Ekyo kyandibadde ng’ovuma omulangira, n’omenya amateeka ge, n’onoonya okufa kwe, n’ogamba nti ebyo byonna wabikola okumusanyusa.

Kale ani asanyukira ekibi kyammwe n’okufa kwammwe? Si abo abalina ekifaananyi kya Katonda, kubanga bateekwa okuba n’endowooza ng’eyiye. Katonda amanyi nti tekisanyusa n’akatono abasomesa bammwe abeesigwa okubalaba nga muweereza omulabe wammwe atta, nga mwesimbawo obulamu bwammwe obutaggwaawo mu ngeri ey’eddalu, era nga mwagala ne mwesuula mu nnimi z’omuliro gwa ggeyeena. Tekibasanyusa n’akatono okulaba ku myoyo gyammwe (mu bibala byabyo eby’ennaku) obuzibe bw’amaaso ng’obwo, n’obukakanyavu bw’omutima, n’obulagajjavu, n’okwekakasa okw’amalala; obukakanyavu ng’obwo mu bubi, n’obutayagala kuyigirizibwa, n’okwerema ng’okwo eri amakubo g’obulamu n’emirembe. Bamanyi nti bino bubonero bwa kufa n’obw’obusungu bwa Katonda, era bamanyi okuva mu kigambo kya Katonda enkomerero yaabyo ky’eyinza okuba; n’olwekyo tekibasanyusa okusinga bwe kisanyusa omusawo ow’ekisa okulaba obubonero bwa kawumpuli nga bubutuka ku mulwadde we. Woowe! Okulengera ebibonoobono byammwe ebitaggwaawo, n’obutamanya ngeri ya kubiziyiza! Okulaba nga muli kumpi nnyo ne ggeyeena, ate nga tetusobola kubakkirizisa kino wadde okubalowoozesa ku kyo! Okulaba nga mwandiwonye mu ngeri ennyangu era ennambulukufu, singa twali tumanyi bumanya engeri y’okubafuula abeetegefu! Nga musemberedde nnyo obulokozi obutaggwaawo, singa mwakyuka bukyusi ne mukola kyonna kye musobola, ne mukifuula ekyo kye mufaako n’omulimu gw’obulamu bwammwe! naye temwagala kukikola. Ne bwe kyandibadde nti obulamu bwaffe bwesigamye ku kyo, tetusobola kubasendasenda kukikola: Tusoma emisana n’ekiro kye tunaabagamba ekiyinza okubakakasa n’okubasendasenda, naye tekikolebwa: Tubateeka mu maaso ekigambo kya Katonda, ne tubalaga essuula n’olunyiriri lwennyini we kyawandiikibwa nti temuyinza kulokolebwa okuggyako nga mukyusiddwa, naye abasinga obungi mu mmwe tubaleka nga bwe twabasanga:—Tusuubira nti mujja kukkiriza ekigambo kya Katonda, newaakubadde nga ffe temutukkiriza, era nti mujja kukissaako omwoyo bwe tubalaga ekyawandiikibwa ekitegeerekeka obulungi; naye tusuubira bwereere, era tukola bwereere, ku nsonga y’enkyukakyuka yonna erokola mu mitima gyammwe. Era mulowooza nti kino kitusanyusa? Emirundi mingi mu kusaba okw’ekyama tuwalirizibwa okwemulugunyiza Katonda nga tulina emitima egy’ennaku nti, “Woowe! Mukama, twayogera nabo mu linnya lyo, naye tebatussaako mwoyo n’akatono: Twabategeeza bye watulagira okubategeeza ku kabi k’embeera y’omuntu atannakyuka, naye tebatukkiriza; twabategeeza nti walangirira nti “Tewali mirembe eri aboonoonyi,” (Isaaya 48:22 ne 57:21) naye abasinga obubi mu bonna kumpi tebakkiriza nti babi; twabalaga ekigambo kyo, we wagamba nti “bwe munaagobereranga omubiri, mugenda kufa;” (Abaruumi 8:13) naye boogera nti, “Bajja kukukkiririzaamu, newaakubadde nga tebakkiriza by’oyogera; nti bajja kukwesiga, newaakubadde nga tebassa bwesige mu kigambo kyo; era bwe basuubira nti okutiisa okw’omu bigambo byo kwa bulimba, bakyayita ekyo okusuubira mu Katonda; era newaakubadde nga tubalaga we wagamba nti Omukozi w’ebibi bw’afa, essuubi lye libula, naye tetusobola kubaggya mu ssuubi lyabwe ery’obulimba,” (Engero 11:7).—Tubabuulira ekibi nga bwe kiri ekintu ekinyoomebwa era ekitaliiko mugaso; naye bakyagala, n’olwekyo tebaagala kukireka.—Tubabuulira nga bwe bagula essanyu lino ku muwendo omungi, era nti balina okulisasulira mu kubonaabona okutaggwaawo; naye beesiima, ne batakikkiriza; wabula bajja kukola ng’abasinga obungi bwe bakola: era, olw’okuba Katonda wa kisa, tebaagala kumukkiriza, wabula bajja kwesimbawo emyoyo gyabwe, kyonna ekinaavaamu kijje. Tubabuulira nga Mukama bw’ali omwetegefu okubasembeza; naye kino kibaleetera bulesi kwongezaayo kwenenya kwabwe n’okwongera okuguma mu kibi kyabwe.—Abamu ku bo boogera nti bagenderera okwenenya, naye bakyali bwe bali; n’abalala boogera nti beenenyezza dda, so nga tebannakyuka kuva mu bibi byabwe. Tubabuulirira, tubeegayirira, tubawa obuyambi bwaffe, naye tetubawangula; abaali abatamiivu bakyali batamiivu; n’abaali abantu ab’ennaku abeemalira ku binyumu n’okusanyusa omubiri bakyali bwe batyo; n’abaali abaagala ensi bakyagala ensi; n’abaali abatamanyi, ab’amalala era abeegulumiza, bakyali bwe batyo.—Batono ku bo abanaalaba ekibi kyabwe ne bakyatula, era batono n’okusingawo abanaakireka, wabula beebudaabuda nti abantu bonna boonoonyi; ng’olinga tewali njawulo wakati w’omwonoonyi eyakyuka n’oyo atannakyuka. Abamu ku bo tebaagala na kutusemberera bwe tuba beetegefu okubayigiriza, wabula balowooza nti bamala dda, era tebeetaaga kuyigiriza kwaffe; n’abalala batuwuliriza, ne bakola kye baagala; era abasinga bali ng’abafu abatayinza kuwulira; n’olwekyo, bwe tubabuulira ku bintu ebirina ebiva mu byo ebitaggwaawo, tetuyinza kutuusa kigambo na kimu ku mitima gyabwe. Bwe tutabagondera ne tubasanyusa nga tubatiza abaana b’abo abakakanyavu ennyo mu bubi, ne tubawa Ekyeggulo kya Mukama, ne tukola byonna bye baagala tukole, ne bwe biba nga bikontana nnyo n’ekigambo kya Katonda, batukyawa ne batuvuma; naye bwe tubeegayirira bwegayirizi okwatula ebibi byabwe ne babireka, ne balokola emyoyo gyabwe, tebaagala kukikola.—Tubagamba nti, bwe banaakyuka bukyusi, tetujja kubamma kiragiro na kimu ekya Katonda, wadde okubatiza abaana baabwe, wadde Ekyeggulo kya Mukama gye bali bennyini; naye tebatuwuliriza. Baagala tujeemere Katonda, tuzikirize emyoyo gyaffe okubasanyusa, naye bo tebaagala kukyuka ne balokola emyoyo gyabwe okusanyusa Katonda.—Beeraba ng’abagezi okusinga abasomesa baabwe bonna; banyiiga era beekakasa mu kkubo lyabwe, era ne bwe twandyagadde nnyo nnyini, tetuyinza kubakyusa. Mukama, eno ye mbeera ya baliraanwa baffe abali mu nnaku, era tetuyinza kugiyamba; tubalaba nga bali kumpi kugwa mu ggeyeena, era tetuyinza kubayamba; tumanyi nti singa bakyuka mu mazima bandirokoleddwa, naye tetuyinza kubasendasenda; ne bwe twandibeegayiridde nga tufukamidde, tetuyinza kubasendasenda; ne bwe twandibeegayiridde n’amaziga, tetuyinza kubasendasenda; kati kiki ekirala kye tuyinza okukola?”

Kuno kwe kwemulugunya n’okusinda okw’ekyama abasumba bangi abaavu kwe bawalirizibwa okukola. Era mulowooza nti kino kimusanyusa? Kimusanyusa okubalaba nga mweyongera mu kibi, ate nga tayinza kubakomya? Okubalaba nga muli mu nnaku bwe mutyo, ate nga tayinza wadde okubategeeza ekyo; okubalaba nga musanyuka, so nga temuli bakakafu nti mu ssaawa emu temujja kuba mu ggeyeena? Okulowooza ku ebyo bye mulina okubonaabona emirembe gyonna, kubanga temwagala kukyuka? Era okulowooza ku bulamu obutaggwaawo obw’ekitiibwa bwe mwagala ne munyooma ne musuula? Kiki ekisinga ennaku kye muyinza okuleeta ku mitima gyabwe? Era muyinza mutya okusala amagezi okubanakuwaza okusingawo?

Kale ani gwe musanyusa olw’ekibi kyammwe n’okufa kwammwe? Si mikwano gyammwe egitya Katonda era egitegeera. Woowe, kibanakuwaza nnyo mu myoyo gyabwe okulaba ennaku yammwe; era babakaabira emirundi mingi, newaakubadde nga mubeebaza kitono olw’ekyo, era nga temulina mitima gya kwekaabira mwekka.

Kale ani asanyukira ekibi kyammwe? Tewali mulala wabula abalabe ba Katonda abakulu abasatu, be mwegaana mu kubatizibwa kwammwe, ate kaakano ne mubakyukira mu ngeri ey’obulimba okubaweereza.

1. Setaani ddala asanyukira ekibi kyammwe n’okufa kwammwe; kubanga eno y’enkomerero yennyini ey’okukema kwe kwonna. Olw’ekyo, atunula emisana n’ekiro: temuyinza kulowooza ngeri ndala gye mwandimusanyusizzaamu okusinga okweyongera mu kibi: nga asanyuka nnyo bw’akulaba ng’ogenda mu bbaala, oba mu kibi ekirala, era bw’abawulira nga mukolima, oba nga mulayira, oba nga muvuma? Nga asanyuka nnyo bw’akuwulira ng’ovuma omusumba ayagala okukuggya mu kibi kyo n’okuyamba okukulokola? Bino bye bimusanyusa.

2. N’ababi nabo bakisanyukira; kubanga kituukagana n’obutonde bwabwe.

3. Naye mmanyi, ne bino byonna, nti si kusanyusa Setaani kye mugenderera, ne bwe mumusanyusa; wabula omubiri gwammwe, omulabe asinga obukulu era asinga obulabe, gwe mugenderera okusanyusa. Gwe mubiri ogwagala okuwembejjebwa, ogwagala okusanyusibwa mu mmere, n’ebyokunywa, n’engoye; ogwagala okusanyusibwa mu banno, n’okusanyusibwa mu kutenderezebwa n’ekitiibwa mu nsi, n’okusanyusibwa mu mizannyo, ne mu kwegomba, ne mu bugayaavu: kino kye kinnya ekimira byonna. Ono ye katonda yennyini gwe muweereza, kubanga ekyawandiikibwa kyogera ku bantu ng’abo nti “okulya kubafuukidde katonda waabwe,” (Abafiripi 3:18).

Naye mbeegayiridde, mulindeko katono mulowooze ku nsonga eno.

1. Ekibuuzo. Omubiri gwammwe gwandisanyusiziddwa okusooka Omutonzi wammwe? Munaanyiiza Mukama, ne munyiiza abasomesa bammwe, ne mikwano gyammwe egitya Katonda, byonna olw’okusanyusa okwegomba kwammwe okw’ensolo, oba okuyaayaana kw’omubiri? Katonda tasaanira kuba mufuzi wa mubiri gwammwe? Bw’atagufuga, tagenda kugulokola; temuyinza mu magezi kusuubira nti alikikola.

2. Ekibuuzo. Omubiri gwammwe gusanyuka olw’ekibi kyammwe; naye omuntu wammwe ow’omunda asanyuka? Teyeemulugunya munda mu mmwe n’abagamba oluusi nti byonna si birungi, era nti embeera yammwe si nnungi nga bwe mugifuula? era emmeeme yammwe n’omuntu wammwe ow’omunda tebyandisanyusiziddwa okusooka omubiri gwammwe oguvunda?

3. Ekibuuzo. Naye omubiri gwammwe tegwetegekera nagwo kunyiiga? Gwagala emmere eri ku ddobo, naye gwagala eddobo lyennyini? Gwagala omwenge omukambwe n’obutole obuwoomu; gwagala okuwummula kwagwo, n’emizannyo, n’okusanyuka: gwagala okuba omugagga, n’okwogerwako obulungi abantu, n’okuba omuntu ow’enkizo mu nsi: naye gwagala ekikolimo kya Katonda? Gwagala okuyimirira nga gukankana mu maaso g’entebe ye ey’omusango, n’okusalirwa omusango ogw’omuliro ogutaggwaawo? Gwagala okubonyaabonyezebwa wamu ne dayimooni emirembe gyonna?—Bitwale byonna wamu: kubanga tewali kwawukanya kibi ne ggeyeena, okuggyako olw’okukkiriza n’okukyuka okw’amazima; bw’onookuuma ekimu, oteekwa okufuna n’ekirala. Okufa ne ggeyeena bwe biba nga bibasanyusa, kale si kya kwewuunya bwe mweyongera mu kibi; naye, bwe biba nga tebibasanyusa (nga bwe nkakasa nti tebibasanyusa), kale ne bwe kyandibadde nti ekibi kiwooma nnyo nnyini, kisaanira okufiirwa obulamu obutaggwaawo? Akatono k’ekyokunywa, oba emmere, oba okuwummula; ekigambo ekirungi eky’aboonoonyi; obugagga bw’ensi eno, bisaanira okutwalibwa nga bya muwendo okusinga essanyu ery’omu ggulu? Oba bisaanira okubonaabona mu muliro ogutaggwaawo?

Ebibuuzo bino byandirowoozeddwako nga temunnayongera mu maaso, buli muntu alina amagezi okulowooza, era akkiriza nti alina emmeeme ey’okulokolebwa oba ey’okubula.

Kale, Mukama wano alayira nti tasanyukira kufa kwammwe, wabula nti mukyuke mubeere balamu; bwe munaayagala ne mweyongera ne mufa okusinga okukyuka, mujjukire nti temwakikola kusanyusa Katonda; mwakikola kusanyusa nsi, n’okwesanyusa mwekka. Era, abantu bwe beezikiriza okwesanyusa bokka, ne beesuula mu kubonaabona okutaggwaawo olw’essanyu, ne batalina magezi, wadde omutima, wadde ekisa, okuwuliriza Katonda oba omuntu ayagala okubakomyawo, kiki ekiyinza okukolebwa? Bateekwa okutwala kye bafuna mu kyo, ne bakyejjusa mu ngeri endala, nga kikeereye! Nga sinnayongera mu maaso mu kukozesa kuno, nja kutuuka ku njigiriza eddako; ekimpa omusingi omunywevu okusingawo.

Enjigiriza 5. Katonda ayagala nnyo aboonoonyi okukyuka, n’atuuka n’okuddiŋŋana ebiragiro bye n’okubuulirira kwe n’amaanyi: “Mukyuke, mukyuke! Lwaki mufa?”

Enjigiriza eno kwe kukozesa okw’eyasooka, ng’okubuulirira, era bwe ntyo bwe nnaagikwata.

Waliwo omwonoonyi atannakyuka awulira ebigambo bya Katonda bino eby’amaanyi? Waliwo omusajja oba omukazi yenna mu kuŋŋaaniro lino akyali mugwira eri omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ogw’okuzza obuggya n’okutukuza? Kuŋŋaaniro lya mukisa, bwe kiba nga si bwe kiri eri abasinga obungi. Kale muwulirize eddoboozi ly’Omutonzi wammwe, mumukyukire nga muyita mu Kristo awatali kulwa. Mwagala okumanya Katonda ky’ayagala? Kale kino kye kyagala kye, nti mukyuke kaakano. Katonda omulamu anaaweereza ebitonde bye obubaka obw’amaanyi bwe butyo, ne bitagonda? Kale muwulirize, mmwe mwenna abagoberera omubiri; Mukama, eyakuwa omukka gw’obulamu n’okubeerawo kwo, abaweerezza obubaka okuva mu ggulu; era buno bwe bubaka bwe, “Mukyuke, mukyuke! Lwaki mufa?” Alina amatu agawulira, awulire. Eddoboozi ly’Obukulu obutaggwaawo linaalagajjalirwa? Bw’abwatuka obubwatuki n’entiisa, otya. Naye ekigambo kino kikwata ku bulamu bwo oba okufa kwo okutaggwaawo. Kiragiro era kubuulirira. Ng’olinga yakugamba nti, “Nkulagira, olw’obwesigwa bw’olina okumpa nze Omutonzi wo era Omununuzi wo, okwegaana omubiri, n’ensi, ne Setaani, onkyukire obeere mulamu. Neetoowaza okukwegayirira, nga bw’oyagala oba bw’otya oyo eyakutonda: nga bw’oyagala obulamu bwo, weewaawo obulamu bwo obutaggwaawo, Kyuka obeere mulamu: nga bw’oyagala okuwona ennaku etaggwaawo, “Kyuka, kyuka, kubanga lwaki ofa?” Era waliwo omutima mu muntu, mu kitonde ekirina amagezi, oguyinza okugaana obubaka ng’obwo, ekiragiro ng’ekyo, okubuulirira ng’okwo? Woowe, kale omutima gw’omuntu kintu ki!

Kale muwulirize, mmwe mwenna abeeyagala, nammwe mwenna abafaayo ku bulokozi bwammwe:—Buno bwe bubaka obusinga essanyu obwali buweerezeddwa mu matu g’omuntu, “Mukyuke, mukyuke! Lwaki mufa?” Temunnasibirwa mu kuggwaamu essuubi. Wano mubaweereddwa ekisa; mukyuke, mujja kukifuna. Woowe, nga mwandyanirizza amawulire gano n’emitima egy’essanyu! Mmanyi nti guno si gwe mulundi ogusooka nga mukiwulira; naye mwakissaako mutya omwoyo, oba mukissaako mutya omwoyo kaakano? Muwulire, mmwe mwenna aboonoonyi abatamanyi era abalagajjavu, ekigambo kya Mukama! Muwulire, mmwe mwenna abaagala ensi, mmwe abasanyusa omubiri; mmwe abalule, n’abatamiivu, n’abenzi, n’abalayizi; mmwe abavumi n’abageya, abawaayiriza n’abalimba: “Mukyuke, mukyuke! Lwaki mufa?”

Muwulire, mmwe mwenna abatalina kwagala kwa Katonda, abatalina mitima gimwolekedde, wadde egyemalidde ku ssuubi ly’ekitiibwa, wabula abassa ekitiibwa ekisingawo ku bugagga bwammwe obw’ensi n’essanyu lyammwe okusinga essanyu ery’omu ggulu; mmwe mwenna abasinza Katonda katono ku mabbali, ne mumuwa ekyo kyokka omubiri gwammwe kye gusobola okuwaayo; abateegaanye bwe muli mu mubiri, ne mutaleka byonna bye mulina ku lwa Kristo, mu kutwala kw’emyoyo gyammwe ne mu kumalirira kwagyo okunywevu, wabula mulina ekintu kimu mu nsi kye mwagala ennyo nga temuyinza kukiwaayo ku lwa Kristo, singa akibasaba, wabula mwandisinze okwesimbawo obusungu bwe okusinga okukireka; “Mukyuke, mukyuke! Lwaki mufa?”

Bwe mutaakiwulirangako, oba bwe mutaakissangako mwoyo, mujjukire nti mwakibuuliddwa okuva mu kigambo kya Katonda leero, nti bwe munaakyuka bukyusi, munaaba balamu; era bwe mutaakyuke, mulifa ddala.

Kati munaakola ki, Bassebo? Kiki kye mumaliridde? Munaakyuka, oba temugenda kukyuka? Temukyatta aganaaga: Obanga Mukama ye Katonda mumugoberere; omubiri gwammwe bwe guba katonda, kale mweyongere okuguweereza. Eggulu bwe liba nga lisinga ensi n’essanyu ly’omubiri, kale mujje, munoonye ensi esinga obulungi, era “mweterekerenga obugagga bwammwe gye butayinza kwonoonebwa nnyenje wadde obutalagge, n’ababbi gye batayinza kuyingira kububba, era ku nkomerero muzuukuke n’amaanyi gammwe gonna okunoonya obwakabaka obutanyeenyezebwa,” (Abaebbulaniya 12:28) era okukozesa obulamu bwammwe ku kigendererwa ekisingako obugulumivu, ne mukyusa omugga gw’ebyo bye mweraliikirira n’emirimu gyammwe mu kkubo eddala okuva ku ekyo kye mwakolanga edda. Naye, ensi bw’eba nga esinga eggulu, oba nga ejja kubakolera ebisingawo, oba nga ejja kubeerera ebbanga eddene, kale mugikuume, mugifunemu kye musobola, mweyongere okugigoberera. Mumaliridde kye munaakola? Bwe muba nga temunnamalirira, nja kubateeka mu maaso ensonga endala ntono eziwaliriza, ndabe oba ng’amagezi ganaabamalirizisa.

Lowooza okusooka, “Ekisa kye kyategese ki olw’obulokozi bwammwe:” era nga kya nnaku nnyo omuntu yenna okuzikirira oluvannyuma lw’ebyo byonna. Waaliwo ekiseera, ekitala ekyaka omuliro lwe kyali mu kkubo, n’ekikolimo ky’amateeka ga Katonda kyandikuziyizza, ne bwe wandibadde omwetegefu ennyo okukyukira Katonda: Waaliwo ekiseera ggwe wennyini, ne mikwano gyo gyonna gy’olina mu nsi, lwe mutandisobodde kukufunira kusonyiyibwa bibi byo eby’emabega, ne bwe wandibikungubagidde ennyo ne obireka. Naye Kristo yaggyawo ekiziyiza kino olw’omutango gw’omusaayi gwe. Waaliwo ekiseera Katonda lwe yali tatabaganye n’akatono, kubanga obwenkanya bwe bwali tebunnatuukirizibwa olw’okumenya amateeka ge: naye kaakano obwenkanya bwe butuukiriziddwa era atabaganye nnyo, n’atuuka n’okukuwa etteeka ery’obwereere ery’okusonyiwa n’okwerabira ebisobyo, n’ekiwandiiko eky’obwereere eky’ekirabo kya Kristo n’obulamu, n’akikuwa, n’akwegayirira okukikkiriza, era kiyinza okuba ekikyo, bw’onooyagala. “Kubanga Katonda yali mu Kristo, ng’atabagana n’abantu, n’atuteresa ffe obubaka obw’okutabaganya,” (2 Abakkolinso 5:18-19). Aboonoonyi, naffe tulagiddwa okubatuusaako obubaka buno mwenna, ng’okuva eri Mukama, “Mujje byonna biwedde okutegeka,” (Lukka 14:17). Byonna biwedde okutegeka, nammwe temunnaba kwetegeka? Katonda mwetegefu okubaaniriza, n’okubasonyiwa byonna bye mumukoze, bwe munajja bujja. Ne bwe mumaze ebbanga eddene nga mwonoona, ne bwe mwonoonye nga mwagala, mwetegefu okusuula byonna emabega we, bwe munajja bujja. Newaakubadde nga mubadde bajaajaamya, ne mudduka Katonda, ne mulwayo nnyo, mwetegefu n’okubasisinkana, n’okubawambaatira mu mikono gye, n’okusanyukira okukyuka kwammwe, bwe munaakyuka bukyusi.—Wadde omwagazi w’ensi n’omutamiivu ali ng’embizzi bajja kusanga Katonda nga mwetegefu okubaaniriza, bwe banajja bujja. Kino tekikyusa mutima gwo munda mu ggwe?—Ayi omwonoonyi, bw’oba olina omutima ogw’ennyama, so si ogw’ejjinja munda mu ggwe, ndowooza kino kyandigusaanuusizza. Obukulu obutaliiko kkomo obw’Eggulu bunaakulindirira okudda, ne buba bwetegefu okukwaniriza ggwe eyamuvuma, n’omwerabira ebbanga eddene bwe lityo? Anaasanyukira okukyuka kwo, oyo eyandiyinzizza essaawa yonna okugulumiza obwenkanya bwe mu kuzikirira kwo, ate kino ne kitasaanuusa mutima gwo munda mu ggwe, ne kaakano tonnaba kwetegeka kuyingira? Tolina nsonga nnyingi z’okuba omwetegefu okujja nga Katonda bw’alina ensonga ez’okukuyita n’okukwaniriza?

Naye, ekyo si kye kyokka: Kristo yakola omugabo gwe ku musaalaba, n’akuteerawo ekkubo eri Kitaffe, nti ku lulwe oyinza okwanirizibwa bw’onojja. Naye tonnaba kwetegeka?

Okusonyiyibwa kwakuweebwa dda mu bulambulukufu era kukuweereddwa mu njiri. Naye tonnaba kwetegeka?

Abaweereza b’enjiri beetegefu okukuyamba, okukuyigiriza; beetegefu okukusabira, n’okussa akabonero ku kusonyiyibwa kwo nga bakuwa ssakalamentu entukuvu; naye tonnaba kwetegeka?

Bonna abatya Katonda abakwetoolodde beetegefu okusanyukira okukyuka kwo, n’okukusembeza mu kussa kimu kw’abatukuvu, n’okukuwa omukono ogwa ddyo ogw’okussa kimu, weewaawo, ne bwe wandibadde omu ku baagobebwa mu kibiina kyabwe: tebaguma kugaana kusonyiwa Katonda gy’asonyiwa, bwe kiba kibalabikidde lwatu, olw’okwatula kwo n’okukyusa empisa: tebaguma na kukuyeeyereza bibi byo eby’edda, kubanga bamanyi nti Katonda tajja kubikunenya. Ne bwe wandibadde ow’ekivume ekinene ennyo, bw’onookyuka obukyusi n’omutima gwo gwonna n’oyingira, tebandikugaanye, ensi k’eyogere ky’eyagala ku kyo. Era, bano bonna beetegefu okukwaniriza, naye ggwe tonnaba kwetegeka kuyingira?

Weewaawo, n’eggulu lyennyini lyetegefu; Mukama ajja kukusembeza mu kitiibwa ky’abatukuvu be, ggwe ensolo embi gy’obadde: bw’onookkiriza bukkiriza okunaazibwa, oyinza okufuna ekifo mu maaso g’entebe ye ey’obwakabaka; bamalayika be bajja kuba beetegefu okukuuma emmeeme yo okutuuka mu kifo eky’essanyu, bw’onooyingira obuyingizi mu mazima. Era Katonda mwetegefu, ssaddaaka ya Kristo yeetegefu, ekisuubizo kyetegefu, n’okusonyiyibwa kwetegefu?—Abaweereza beetegefu, n’abantu ba Katonda beetegefu, n’eggulu lyennyini lyetegefu, ne bamalayika beetegefu, era bano bonna balindirira kukyuka kwammwe kwokka, naye ggwe tonnaba kwetegeka? Ki! Tonnaba kwetegeka kuba mulamu, nga mubadde bafu okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo? Tonnaba kwetegeka kudda mu magezi go amatuufu, ng’omwana omujaajaamya bwe kyogerwa nti yeddamu, (Lukka 15:17) nga obadde ng’eyagwa eddalu okumala ebbanga eddene bwe lityo? Tonnaba kwetegeka kulokolebwa, nga kumpi oli mwetegefu okusalirwa omusango?—Tonnaba kwetegeka kwekwata ku Kristo, ayagala okukununula, nga kumpi oli mwetegefu okubbira n’okusaanawo mu kuzikirira? Tonnaba kwetegeka kulokolebwa okuva mu ggeyeena, nga kumpi oli mwetegefu okusuulibwamu awatali kuwona? Woowe, omuntu ggwe! Omanyi ky’okola? Bw’onoofa nga tonnakyuka tewali kubuusabuusa ku kuzikirira kwo, era tokakasa kuba mulamu wadde essaawa emu: naye tonnaba kwetegeka kukyuka n’okuyingira? Ayi omwonoonyi ow’ennaku! Tonnaweereza mubiri ne Setaani ebbanga eriwera? Ekibi tonnakikkuta? Kikuwoomera nnyo bwe kityo; oba kikugasa nnyo bwe kityo?—Omanyi kye kiri, olyoke oyagale okukifunako ekisingawo? Wafuna okuyitibwa okungi bwe kutyo, n’ebisa ebingi bwe bityo, n’ebibonerezo ebingi bwe bityo, n’ebyokulabirako ebingi bwe bityo? Walaba bangi bwe batyo nga bateekebwa mu ntaana, naye tonnaba kwetegeka kuleka bibi byo, n’ojja eri Kristo? Ki! Oluvannyuma lw’okukakasibwa okungi bwe kutyo, n’okulumibwa omuntu ow’omunda, oluvannyuma lw’ebigendererwa n’ebisuubizo ebingi bwe bityo, tonnaba kwetegeka kukyuka obeere mulamu?—Woowe, singa amaaso go, omutima gwo, byazibulwa, omanye ekirabo ekirungi ennyo ekikuweereddwa kaakano! era nga bubaka bwa ssanyu bwe tutumiddwa, okubagamba nti Mujje byonna biwedde okutegeka.

2. Lowooza era, okuyitibwa kw’olina okukyuka obeere mulamu. Nga kungi, nga kwa ddoboozi ddene, nga kwa maanyi, nga kwa ntiisa, naye ate nga kuzzaamu amaanyi, kwa ssanyu.

Kubanga omuyisi asinga obukulu ye Katonda yennyini. Oyo alagira eggulu n’ensi, akulagira okukyuka; era kaakano, awatali kulwa, okukyuka: Alagira enjuba okutambula mu kkubo lyayo, n’okukuvaayo buli ku makya; era newaakubadde nga kitonde kya kitiibwa nnyo bwe kityo, era nga esinga ensi yonna obunene emirundi mingi, naye emugondera, era tesubwa wadde edakiika emu ku kiseera kyayo ekyagiterekerwa. Alagira emmunyeenye zonna n’ebiri waggulu mu ggulu, ne bigonda.—Alagira ennyanja okukka n’okujjula, n’ebitonde byonna okukuuma ekkubo lyabyo, era byonna bimugondera.
